description:
**Company Description**

NIQ is the world’s leading consumer intelligence company, delivering the most complete understanding of consumer buying behavior and revealing new pathways to growth. In 2023, NIQ combined with GfK, bringing together the two industry leaders with unparalleled global reach. With a holistic retail read and the most comprehensive consumer insights—delivered with advanced analytics through state-of-the-art platforms—NIQ delivers the Full View™.

NIQ, is an Advent International portfolio company with operations in 100+ markets, covering more than 90% of the world’s population. For more information, visit NIQ.com.

 **Job Description**

Our NielsenIQ Technology teams are working on revamping multiple platform, a unified, global, open data ecosystem powered by Microsoft Azure. Our clients around the world rely on NielsenIQ’s data and insights to innovate and grow.

As a Big Data Software Engineer, you’ll be part of a team of smart, highly skilled technologists who are passionate about learning and prototyping cutting-edge technologies. Ingestion Services is working on unifying and standardizing several varied ingestion methodologies and convergence initiatives with latest Big Data services on Spark, Scala, Databricks, PySpark and leverage GitHub to support things like CI/CD and integrations and continuing to adopt the best in class cloud-native, cloud-agnostic technologies. Our team is co-located and agile, with central technology hubs in Chennai and Pune. Expertise in Spark, Scala, Databricks are mandatory. Skills in PySpark, GitHub, AI, Azure are welcome additions. AI readiness and DevSecOps exposure are key additional facets to possess and exhibit.

* Understanding user needs and how they fit into the overall, global solution design

* Prototyping new features and integrations aligned to business strategy by introducing innovation through technology
* Following source & test-driven development best practices
* Troubleshooting and identifying root cause analysis while resolving the issues

Must Have -

* 3-6 years of experience as a Big Data engineer who works on enterprise standard frameworks like Spark, Scala, Databricks, PySpark
* Development experience in unit and integration test cases
* Intermediate level of Database (SQL) skills to work with SQL queries, functions
* Good Understanding on CI/CD Pipeline i.e. GitHub Actions

* Demonstrated ability to thrive in an enterprise Agile/SCRUM environment

* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills and excellent English communication skills, with the ability to effectively interface across cross-functional technology teams and the business

Nice to have -

* Minimum B.S. degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or related field
* Experience using Collaboration Technologies: GitHub, Jira, Confluence
* Experience using Object-oriented languages Java
* Experience working with testing tools and Automation test needs
* Motivated, high-potential performer, with demonstrated ability to influence and lead.
* Strong communicator with excellent interpersonal skills.
* Able to solve complex problems and successfully manage ambiguity and unexpected change.
* Teachable and embracing of best practices and feedback as a means of continuous improvement.
* Consistently high achiever marked by perseverance, humility and a positive outlook in the face of challenges.

  
**Additional Information**  

* Enjoy a flexible and rewarding work environment with peer-to-peer recognition platforms.

title: Lead Data Engineer – Azure
description:
**Lead Data Engineer – Azure**

*Data Engineering · Full-time*

**Experience:**8+ years

**Location:**Chennai / Bangalore

**Team Size Managed:** 5+ engineers

**Key Skills:** Azure Data Factory, Databricks, PySpark, SQL

**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced Lead Data Engineer to own the technical architecture, design, and delivery of data engineering solutions for our customers on the Microsoft Azure platform. You will lead a team of data engineers, set technical direction, and ensure our data platforms are scalable, secure, and reliable — while staying hands-on with the architecture and implementation of modern data warehouse and data lake solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Technical Architecture & Design**

* Lead technical architecture and design for data engineering solution components across business initiatives.
* Design and implement scalable, secure, and resilient data engineering solutions on Microsoft Azure, applying sound data architecture patterns.
* Evaluate and select the right technology stack — cloud-native services, open-source tools, data storage, and processing frameworks.

**Data Engineering Development**

* Lead, mentor, and manage a team of data engineers through the development, testing, and deployment of data pipelines, ensuring quality, performance, and on-time delivery.
* Own detailed technical design and data mapping specifications.
* Champion best practices, coding standards, and continuous improvement in code quality and delivery excellence.
* Optimize data solutions for performance, cost-efficiency, and scalability.
* Ensure data quality and integrity for all downstream systems and applications.

**Technical Project Management**

* Plan, prioritize, and manage data engineering projects to ensure timely, high-quality delivery.
* Identify and mitigate risks, troubleshoot issues, and manage customer escalations.
* Align delivery with business requirements and priorities, partnering closely with internal and customer stakeholders.

**Collaboration & Documentation**

* Maintain comprehensive technical documentation — architecture diagrams, high-level/low-level integration design, data mapping specs, and database design.
* Partner with BI engineers and data scientists to enable advanced analytics, machine learning models, and reporting solutions.

**What We're Looking For**

* 8+ years of hands-on experience delivering data engineering solutions.
* Proven experience leading a team of 5+ engineers, including stakeholder management, design and code reviews, and mentoring.
* Strong hands-on experience with the Microsoft Azure data ecosystem: Azure Data Factory, Azure Functions, Azure Databricks, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Event Hub, Azure Stream Analytics, and Azure Data Lake Storage.
* Expertise in database concepts, SQL, and relational modeling, plus good working experience with NoSQL databases.
* Strong hands-on experience building data pipelines with Python and PySpark.
* Solid grasp of data lake and data warehouse concepts, modern data architecture patterns, and current industry trends.
* Hands-on data modeling experience, with a good understanding of both ER and dimensional modeling.
* Experience implementing data quality management solutions.
* Working knowledge of metadata management for data engineering platforms.
* Understanding of data governance principles, including data stewardship, security, and privacy management.
* Experience with Git for source control and with DevOps practices, including CI/CD pipelines for data engineering components.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

**Nice to Have**

* Azure certifications, preferably in Data Engineering.
* Experience with Azure Logic Apps and API Management.
* Familiarity with BI/visualization tools such as Power BI.

Pay: ₹600,000.00 - ₹1,500,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Microsoft Control Access - Senior Consultant
description:
As an experienced Senior Consultant at Deloitte Consulting, you will deliver high-quality work products within deadlines, actively leading, mentoring, and guiding junior team members. You will collaborate with onsite and offshore teams to understand functional requirements and ensure seamless project execution.

**Work you'll do**

As a Senior Consultant on the Cyber Operate team, you will be responsible for…

* Administer, design, and govern Microsoft Entra Conditional Access policies across production and non-production environments, including policy assignments, conditions, grant controls, session controls, naming standards, and exclusion governance.
* Configure and support access controls for users, groups, roles, cloud applications, guests, workload identities, and devices, including multifactor authentication (MFA), authentication strengths, compliant or hybrid-joined device requirements, and risk-based policies.
* Manage the policy lifecycle through What If analysis, report-only mode, phased rollouts, change records, testing, approvals, rollback planning, post-change validation, and emergency-access account monitoring.
* Provide Level 3 troubleshooting for sign-in and access issues; analyze policy evaluation details, Microsoft Entra sign-in logs, KQL queries, and Microsoft Sentinel data; and manage incident, service request, problem, and change activities in ServiceNow.
* Automate repeatable policy reporting, backup, drift detection, and administration using approved tools, including Microsoft Graph PowerShell; maintain dashboards, reports, runbooks, knowledge articles, and technical documentation.
* Lead client operational reviews and policy-design workshops; coordinate onsite and offshore activities; mentor junior staff; communicate access impacts and remediation actions; and contribute technical insights to managed-services solution design.

**The team**

Deloitte's Cyber Operate teams manage clients' critical cyber assets either as a fully managed service or in partnership with clients. They deliver skilled talent, cutting-edge technologies, and robust processes to operate client cyber capabilities. This includes:

* Managing Identity Lifecycle
* Security Operations
* Threat Intelligence
* Application Security
* Business Transformation
* Continuous Compliance.

Cyber Operate team focuses on efficiently running operations by enabling automation, reducing manual effort and adhering to Service Level Agreements (SLAs) based on the standards set by clients.

**Location: Bengaluru / Hyderabad / Pune / Chennai**

**Shift Timings: 24/7 rotational shifts; on-call support based on project assignment**

**Qualifications**

Required:

Must have skills/ Project experience/ Certifications

* 6 -10 years total experience in IAM or cybersecurity operations, including at least 4 years designing and operating Microsoft Entra Conditional Access in an operational or managed services capacity.
* Expert knowledge of Conditional Access: policy design, grant and session controls, authentication strengths, continuous access evaluation, token protection, report-only mode and What If analysis, risk-based policies (Entra ID Protection), device compliance (Intune), named locations, and emergency-access account design.
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID and hybrid identity: Active Directory, Entra Connect/Cloud Sync, PIM, B2B collaboration, SSO and federation (SAML, OAuth 2.0/OpenID Connect), and MFA/passwordless authentication.
* Solid understanding of Zero Trust and least privilege principles, and of compliance frameworks such as NIST SP 800-53/800-207, ISO 27001, SOC 2, HIPAA, and PCI DSS.
* Technological skills in automation, PowerShell scripting, Microsoft Graph and REST APIs, and KQL for troubleshooting, reporting, and monitoring.
* Deep understanding of operational processes, incident resolution, change management, and compliance management; proficiency with process documentation, SLAs, reporting, and ITSM practices (ServiceNow).
* Experience leading support teams, mentoring juniors, and managing enhancement/implementation projects; able to communicate effectively with stakeholders and clients at all levels.
* Preferred certifications: Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate (SC-300); ITIL.

Preferred:

Good to have skills/ Project experience/ Certifications:

* Microsoft Certified: Cybersecurity Architect Expert (SC-100), Azure Security Engineer (AZ-500), or Security Operations Analyst (SC-200).
* Experience with Global Secure Access, Defender for Cloud Apps, Intune, Defender XDR, and Microsoft Sentinel.
* Experience with Microsoft Security Copilot agents, or Conditional Access policy-as-code (Microsoft Graph, Terraform, Microsoft365DSC, CI/CD pipelines).
* Hands-on experience with other identity platforms (e.g., Okta, Ping) or privileged access tools used in managed services.
* Involvement in process improvement or internal training; CISSP, CISM, or CCSP certification

Education:

* BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited university

**Our purpose**

  
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

**Our people and culture**

  
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.

**Professional development**

  
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India.

**Benefits to help you thrive**

At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.

title: Platform Engineer - AI
description:
TechGrove is the **Centre of Excellence** for Banyan Software, based in Chennai, India. It plays a key role in supporting Banyan's global businesses through technology, security, and software development. TechGrove brings together India's deep pool of technical talent with Banyan's long-term approach to growth, creating a trusted, developer-focused environment where people can do their best work.

About the role  
HWA International builds the trust accounting software that bank trust departments, credit unions,  
foundations, and family offices run their fiduciary operations on. We are an AI-first engineering  
organization, and agentic coding tools are how we build. Our platform is in a significant modernization,  
and this role is one of the engineers who builds it.  
Agentic tooling lets us understand existing behavior and specify what comes next far faster than that  
work could be done by hand. You will use it to do exactly that, then build the modern platform end to  
end: the C# and .NET services, the web front end, and the AWS infrastructure they run on. This is a full-  
stack role, and you own the infrastructure your work runs on.  
Accounting accuracy is the product, so correctness is the bar. Anything new has to produce the same  
results as what it replaces, or better, and proving that is part of the job.  
You will work within an architecture set by engineering leadership, with real influence on it. We work to  
modern engineering standards: trunk-based development on GitHub, continuous integration,  
infrastructure as code, and feature flags.  
What you will do  

* Build the modern platform across the stack. Write features, services, and fixes in C# and .NET,

and the web front end that sits on them, against the architecture and patterns the team has set.  

* Own the infrastructure for what you deliver. Within the cloud architecture engineering

leadership sets, define and maintain your AWS environments as code, along with the  
networking, managed databases, and services behind them, so every environment is  
reproducible and version controlled.  

* Own delivery and observability. Build and run the CI/CD pipelines, staged rollout, and feature

flags that take your work to production, and the monitoring, logging, and alerting that tell us  
how it behaves there.  

* Work out what existing code does and write it down. Use agentic tooling to analyze established

application and database logic, then produce a clear written specification of the behavior that  
has to be preserved.  

* Move business logic into application code and prove it matches. Relocate rules wherever they

live today, including inside the database, into maintainable, tested application code. Build the  
data migration paths and test harnesses that show the modern platform's calculations match  
the existing ones.

* Verify what the tools give you. Agentic tooling drafts the analysis, the documentation, and

much of the code. An agent's account of what existing code does is a hypothesis until you have  
read the code and confirmed it. Characterization tests come before behavior changes.  

* Own the work in production. Whatever ships under your name is yours, from the first analysis

through to how it behaves in production. Take part in incident response, communicate clearly  
while an issue is open, and follow through to root cause and a durable fix.  
What we are looking for  
You do not need to be an expert in every layer. Agentic tools let one strong engineer work across the full  
stack and the infrastructure under it, so we look for depth where judgment matters most, enough  
working knowledge everywhere else to direct the tools and catch their mistakes, and fluency with the  
tools from day one.  
Where you need depth  

* Several years of professional C# and .NET development, with production code you can describe

and defend.  

* Strong relational database skills: schema design, query tuning, and correct transaction and error

handling by reflex. PostgreSQL experience strongly preferred.  

* Demonstrated ability to work out what unfamiliar code does, including code written in a

language or platform you have not used before, and a repeatable method for doing it safely.  

* Agentic coding is table stakes. Deep, hands-on fluency with agentic tools (Claude Code, GitHub

Copilot, Cursor, or similar) as your primary way of working on real production code, from day  
one, with the judgment to treat what they produce as work to be checked rather than answers  
to be shipped.  
Where working knowledge is enough  

* Front end: a modern web framework, React with TypeScript preferred.
* Cloud: AWS (Azure considered), infrastructure as code, networking, managed databases, and

containers.  

* Delivery: CI/CD with automated testing and zero-downtime deployment, plus production

monitoring and alerting.  
Across everything  

* Git and GitHub, with trunk-based development and short-lived branches.
* Comfort owning quality on a system that cannot fail quietly: disciplined testing, observability,

and careful, staged rollout.  

* Clear written and spoken English, because much of your working contact with the team is

written.  

* Availability to work hours that overlap the first half of the US Eastern working day, so you work

with your counterparts rather than around them.  
Nice to have

* Experience in financial services or another regulated, high-stakes domain. Trust accounting,

wealth management, or fiduciary services is a strong plus but is not required. We will teach the  
domain to the right engineer.  

* Experience modernizing an established business application onto a cloud-native stack.
* AWS certification or equivalent depth in security, identity, and cost management on AWS.
* Building software under SOC 1 / SOC 2 or comparable regulated-environment controls.

***Recruitment Notice***

TechGrove may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in screening and/or assessing applicants during the recruitment process. All hiring decisions are made by our team. Personal information submitted through your application will be collected and used for recruitment purposes in accordance with applicable privacy laws. Contact us at any time with questions about our process or to request accommodation.

***Beware of Recruitment Scams***

We have been made aware of individuals fraudulently posing as members of our Talent Acquisition team and extending fake job offers. These scams may involve requests for personal information or payment for equipment.

**Protect yourself by following these steps:**

* Verify that all communications from our recruiting team come from an **@banyansoftware.com** email address.
* Remember, employers will **never** request payment or banking information during the hiring process.
* If you receive a suspicious message, **do not respond** — instead, forward it to careers@banyansoftware.com and/or report it to the platform where you received it.

Your safety and security are important to us. Thank you for staying vigilant.

Are you ready to transform complex configuration data into trusted insight that powers critical services and, ultimately, helps patients receive life-changing medicines faster? In this role you will be the engine behind the accuracy, completeness and timeliness of our ServiceNow CMDB. Your work will remove noise, reduce risk and give our technology and product teams the confidence to move at speed.

From day one, you will own measurable improvements in CMDB health for priority classes and applications. As you scale your impact, you will shape automated controls, streamline certification cycles and provide the insights that steer remediation, modelling decisions and operational resilience.

**Accountabilities:**

CMDB Data Quality Monitoring and Standards: Monitor and improve health across key CI classes and domains, focusing on completeness, accuracy, compliance, freshness and relationships; define measurable targets, track trends and drive actions that move the metrics.

Root Cause Analysis and Controls: Profile data, distinguish isolated vs. systemic issues and document causes; validate against the Data Dictionary; strengthen quality rules and controls to prevent recurrence.

CI Remediation and Lifecycle Integrity: Eliminate duplicates, stale/orphaned CIs and shadow datasets; confirm operational status with owners, correct lifecycle states and retire records appropriately to keep the CMDB trustworthy.

Discovery and Integration Quality: Monitor source-specific exceptions across ServiceNow Discovery, AWS, Azure, Intune, Tanium, VMware, Qualys, Wiz, Claroty and other sources; investigate identification and load anomalies; validate data after changes and engage SMEs for complex fixes.

Service Mapping and Relationship Integrity: Assure the ongoing quality of maps for onboarded applications, identifying missing or broken relationships, stale dependencies and incorrect links; coordinate remediation with owners and track to closure.

CSDM and Modelling Compliance: Review Business/Application Services and infrastructure CIs against modelling standards; flag non-compliance and missing links; coordinate corrections while partnering with SMEs on design decisions.

Ownership, Certification and Governance: Validate CI ownership and support groups; coordinate periodic certification and attestations for CIs and service maps; track overdue actions, escalate through governance and retain evidence of completion.

Build and maintain dashboards and governance reports on CMDB health, ownership, certification, and mapping. Explain issues, root causes, and required actions clearly to collaborators and leadership.

Continuous Improvement and Automation: Identify recurring issues, recommend and operate automated classification, retirement and remediation controls; reduce manual effort and improve time-to-remediation.

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Data / Business Analytics, or equivalent experience.
* At least 3 years of relevant experience in IT Service Management, CMDB, IT asset or configuration management, technology operations, data quality or technology data analysis.
* Practical experience with ServiceNow CMDB, CMDB Health and reporting, including CI classes, attributes and relationships.
* Understanding of ITIL Configuration, Asset, Change and Incident processes and data-quality principles: completeness, accuracy, consistency and timeliness/freshness.
* Experience analysing large configuration, asset or technology data sets, identifying trends, and remediating data-quality issues using profiling, de-duplication, normalisation and root-cause analysis.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, attention to detail and advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
* Experience developing operational reports and dashboards.
* Ability to collaborate across technology teams, drive stakeholder remediation and manage competing priorities independently.
* Clear written and verbal communication and documentation skills.

* SQL/querying and Power BI or equivalent reporting skills; basic scripting or workflow automation experience.
* ITIL 4 Foundation or equivalent; ServiceNow Certified System Administrator or CMDB micro-certifications.
* Experience in biopharmaceuticals, life sciences or another regulated environment.
* Experience working across cultures and time zones, including a Global Technology Centre operating model.
* Knowledge of Agile and Scrum methodologies.

Roche India - Roche Services& Solutions
  
Hyderabad / Chennai
  
  
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.
  
  
That’s what makes us Roche.
  
  
Roche has established Global Analytics and Technology Center of Excellence (GATE) to drive analytics& technology driven solutions by partnering with Roche affiliates across the globe.
  
  
**The Opportunity:**  
TheSenior Analyst – Data Governance Product Management acts as a Technical Product Manager and Senior Data Business Analyst bridging business stakeholders, data governance leads, and data engineering teams. In this role, you will take ownership of defining, documenting, and executing the technical product roadmap for enterprise data governance assets and platforms.
  
  
You will lead business-facing requirements elicitation, maintain enterprise data catalogs (e.g., Collibra), and translate complex pharmaceutical business rules into structured technical specifications, source-to-target mappings, and data quality validation logic.
  
  
In this role, you will have the opportunity to build deep expertise in the external healthcare data ecosystem and contribute to decisions that shape how Roche uses data to support commercial and strategic business needs in the U.S. market.
  
  
You will work closely with U.S. stakeholders, external data vendors, and cross-functional Roche teams. The role provides a strong platform to develop skills in data strategy, vendor evaluation, stakeholder consultation, business problem-solving, and structured communication.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
1. Product Management& Technical Requirements Elicitation
  
  

* Requirements Gathering: Lead discovery and elicitation sessions with business stakeholders, data owners, and technical teams to define data governance product capabilities, workflows, and integrations
* Technical Documentation: Author detailed Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), Source-to-Target Mappings (SSTMs), user stories, data dictionary definitions, and architecture flowcharts using Confluence and Jira
* Product Backlog& Delivery: Manage feature prioritization, sprint backlogs, acceptance criteria, and user acceptance testing (UAT) in an Agile data product delivery environment

2. Data Catalog& Governance Platform Management
  
  

* Catalog Administration& Adoption: Drive enterprise-wide adoption, configuration, and maintenance of Data Catalog platforms (e.g., Collibra), ensuring comprehensive business glossaries, asset definitions, and critical data elements (CDEs)
* Metadata& Lineage: Map end-to-end data lineage, relationships, and metadata attributes across source transactional systems, data lakes, and downstream analytics marts
* Governance Frameworks: Partner with governance leads to establish data classification, taxonomy standards, schema validation, and access policies

3. Domain Data Governance& Stewardship Enablement
  
  

* Pharma Domain Alignment: Act as the technical governance liaison for core pharmaceutical data domains, including Sales, Prescription/Claims, Healthcare Professionals (HCP), Healthcare Organizations (HCO), and Payer/Market Access datasets
* Data Harmonization: Guide cross-functional teams on standardizing master data attributes and cross-referencing domain-specific data definitions across global and regional commercial platforms

4. Data Quality Specification& Rule Design
  
  

* Rule Translation: Translate functional business requirements and governance policies into explicit Data Quality (DQ) validation criteria and SQL-based logic
* Quality Framework Support: Define thresholds and metrics for data completeness, accuracy, consistency, integrity, and freshness to support automated data quality pipelines

5. Business Interfacing& Stakeholder Collaboration
  
  

* Stakeholder Facilitation: Serve as the primary point of contact for US commercial and analytics business users, conducting working sessions and resolving requirements ambiguities
* Time Zone Alignment: Maintain daily working hours overlap with North American business partners operating on US Pacific Standard Time (PST)

**Who you are:**  

* You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Analytics, Data Management, Engineering, or a related discipline and 5+ years of experience
* Advanced SQL Proficiency: Expert-level SQL capabilities for complex data querying, data profiling, lineage tracing, and data validation across relational and distributed data warehouse environments.(Python scripting experience is preferred but not mandatory).
* Technical& Data Requirements Elicitation : Proven track record interfacing directly with business teams to elicit, structure, and document technical data requirements (PRDs, SSTMs, data flow diagrams, Confluence/Jira documentation).
* Data Catalog Platforms: Hands-on operational experience with enterprise Data Catalog solutions, with a strong preference for Collibra (or equivalent enterprise catalog platforms such as Alation)
* Pharmaceutical Commercial Data Domains: Working knowledge of life sciences and pharma commercial data structures, including Sales, Claims/Prescription, HCP, and HCO data domains
* Data Quality& Rule Definition: Practical experience translating complex business requirements into verifiable Data Quality rules and SQL validation logic(preferred; high-level requirements and advanced SQL depth satisfy the core requirement)
* Structured Thinking& Organization: Exceptional ability to distill complex, ambiguous business problems into structured, methodical, and well-organized documentation
* Interpersonal& Verbal Communication: Clear, articulate verbal and written communication skills with proven ability to comfortably interact with director-level business stakeholders and software engineers
* Schedule Alignment: Willingness and availability to align working hours overlapping with US Pacific Standard Time (PST) first half to ensure real-time collaboration with cross-functional teams

**Note:** Work Hours: Flexible with required core overlap with US Pacific Standard Time (PST)

title: Cyber - Data Protection- Databricks Security - Senior Consultant
description:
Join Deloitte Cyber's Data and Digital Trust practice as a Senior Engineering Management Specialist and help clients secure Databricks Lakehouse environments. You will assess security posture, implement governance and access controls, and integrate security capabilities across cloud data platforms. You will collaborate with client, delivery, and vendor teams to deliver practical solutions that support privacy, regulatory, and business objectives.

**Work you'll do**

As a Senior Engineering Management Specialist on the Data and Digital Trust team, you will be responsible for:

* Assess Databricks Lakehouse environments, including workspaces, Unity Catalog, clusters, SQL warehouses, notebooks, jobs, and data pipelines; identify security and regulatory gaps; and prioritize remediation.
* Design and implement data governance and access-control models using Unity Catalog, including metastores, catalogs, schemas, grants, row filters, column masks, and attribute-based access controls.
* Configure platform, network, and identity controls, including private connectivity, secure cluster connectivity, Internet Protocol (IP) access lists, cluster policies, secrets management, customer-managed encryption keys, single sign-on (SSO), System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM) provisioning, and least-privilege access.
* Implement data classification, tagging, lineage, masking, tokenization, Delta Sharing, clean rooms, and cross-cloud or cross-workspace access for sensitive data.
* Enable audit logging and monitoring; integrate Databricks with Security Information and Event Management (SIEM), Security Orchestration, Automation, and Response (SOAR), and cloud security tools; evaluate complementary governance tools; and create architecture and operational documentation with client, delivery, and vendor teams.

**The team**

Data and Digital Trust practice is primarily focused on helping our clients to utilize effective data while safeguarding privacy and security. D&DT solutions prioritize transparency, privacy, and the ethical use of data, assisting organizations in driving sustainable digital transformation. Our solutions assist organizations in meeting the shifting expectations of consumers and create unprecedented business opportunities. We help our clients to define their overall Data protection and Privacy strategy, design global pan-enterprise programs that focus on mitigating threats, evaluate their objectives, priorities, strengths and weaknesses and roll out large scale organizational changes to achieve goals. Our services capture work across advice, implement, and operate solutions. The Data and Digital Trust team delivers services to clients through following key areas:

* Privacy Governance & Compliance
* Data Protection & Compliance
* Digital Trust & Online Protection
* Risk & Controls Enablement
* Technology & Implementation

Our Data and Digital Trust solutions are designed to allow organizations to address requirements stemming from the ever-changing regulatory landscape, consumer expectations, and technological transformations and advancements.

**Location: Bengaluru / Hyderabad / Pune / Chennai**

**Shift Timings: General shift**

**Qualifications**

Required:

* 5–8 years of experience in data security, data protection, or cloud security, including 2+ years securing Databricks environments.
* Experience configuring Databricks security features, including Unity Catalog, access controls, secrets, cluster policies, audit logs, and encryption.
* Experience implementing data classification, masking, and fine-grained access controls in a Lakehouse or big-data environment.
* Experience with data and network security controls in Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Experience using Python, Structured Query Language (SQL), and infrastructure as code with Terraform to automate security configurations.
* Experience integrating Databricks with identity platforms and Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) tools, and creating technical documentation or delivering client training.
* BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent

Preferred:

* Experience with Cyera, Immuta, Privacera, Collibra, BigID, Securiti.ai, or Microsoft Purview.
* Experience with Data Security Posture Management (DSPM), Delta Sharing, or artificial intelligence and machine learning workload security using MLflow, model serving, or Mosaic AI.
* One or more of the following: Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate or Professional certification; Databricks Platform Administrator accreditation; Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA); Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP); Certified Information Security Manager (CISM); Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP); or a cloud security certification from AWS, Azure, or GCP.

title: QC - Senior Test Engineer – Data Annotation
description:
Overview:

Role summary: Independently checks completed annotations against Valeo's guidelines and acceptance criteria before delivery to Valeo. Owns defect logging, rework verification and quality metrics for the team.

Work location

Onsite at Valeo's Chennai premises.

Working pattern

5 days per week, Valeo site calendar and hours

Responsibilities:

* Key responsibilities

  + Validate completed scenes against Valeo's annotation guidelines and acceptance criteria, using full inspection or the agreed sampling plan.
  + Record defects by type and severity (Critical, Major, Minor, Observation). Send work back for rework and verify each fix before closure.
  + Ensure no scene is delivered with open Critical or Major defects.
  + Monitor quality trends by engineer and defect type and support root-cause analysis and targeted coaching.
  + Report quality metrics (first-pass acceptance rate, rework rate, defect density and rework closure time) to the Technical Lead each day and week.
  + Take part in calibration on gold scenes and maintain the guideline FAQ and clarification log with the Technical Lead.
  + Act on feedback from Valeo's acceptance checks and track it to closure.
  + Raise guideline gaps or ambiguities as observations for Valeo to clarify.
  + 6–7 years in QA, testing or data quality, including at least 2 years reviewing or QC-ing annotated data for computer vision.
  + Strong eye for detail on 2D image and/or 3D point-cloud annotations: boxes and cuboids, attributes, class labels, track IDs across frames.
  + Hands-on experience with defect tracking, severity classification and rework workflows.
  + Good command of Excel for quality trackers and metric reporting.
  + Clear written communication for defect feedback.

  Good to have

  + Automotive ADAS or autonomous-driving perception datasets (camera, LiDAR, sensor fusion).
  + Experience with Xtreme1 or similar annotation tools and their review or QC features.
  + Knowledge of statistical sampling and quality-gate approaches.
  + Experience as an annotator before moving into QC.

title: Technical Lead

5 days per week, Valeo site calendar and hours

title: Senior lead security operations
description:
**An Amazing Career Opportunity for Senior Lead Security Operations Engineer**  
**Location: Chennai, India (Hybrid)**  
**Job ID: 52753**

  

**Profile Summary**

The Senior Lead Security Operations Engineer is a senior hands-on security practitioner who provides technical leadership across security monitoring, threat hunting, incident response, network security, vulnerability management, penetration testing, and application security. The role acts as a trusted delegate for the Manager – Security Operations, represents Security Operations in technical and cross-functional forums, and converts identified risk into practical remediation and measurable operational improvement.

  

**About HID Global**

HID Global powers the trusted identities of the world’s people, places and things. We make it possible for people to transact safely, work productively and travel freely. Our trusted identity solutions give people secure and convenient access to physical and digital places and connect things that can be accurately identified, verified and tracked digitally. Millions of people around the world use HID products and services to navigate their everyday lives, and over 2 billion things are connected through HID. We work with governments, educational institutions, hospitals, financial institutions, industrial businesses, and some of the most innovative companies on the planet. Headquartered in Austin, Texas, HID Global has over 4500 employees worldwide and operates international offices that support more than 100 countries. HID Global® is an ASSA ABLOY Group brand. HID Global has is the trusted source for secure identity solutions for millions of customers and users around the world. In India, we have two Engineering Centre (Bangalore and Chennai). Global Engineering Team is based in Chennai and one of the Business Unit Engineering team is based in Bangalore. Check us out: www.hidglobal.com and https://youtu.be/23km5H4K9Eo

LinkedIn: www.linkedin.com/company/hidglobal/mycompany/

  

**Are You Ready to Join the Team?**

Our company is committed to finding the best and the brightest talent to help us reach the top. If you are a dynamic, highly skilled, experienced Cloud engineer and technology enthusiast, and you enjoy working in a rapid pace within a rapidly growing business environment, then you will want to consider this position. If you excel at communication, collaboration, and unrelenting innovation, we want to talk to you. And if you bring dedication, positive energy and integrity to the table, you just might be the right fit for our team.

  

**Qualifications**
  
The individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  

**Key Outcomes**

* Improve detection coverage and investigation quality across endpoint, identity, network, cloud, and application telemetry.
* Lead complex incident investigations from initial triage through containment, eradication, recovery, root-cause analysis, and lessons learned.
* Identify exploitable weaknesses through threat hunting, vulnerability analysis, application security review, and authorized penetration testing.
* Drive remediation with infrastructure, network, cloud, identity, development, and business application owners.
* Mentor SOC engineers, improve playbooks and detection logic, and provide calm technical leadership during high-severity events.

  

**Duties and Responsibilities include and are not limited to the following.**  
Security Operations, Detection & Threat Hunting

* Lead advanced triage and investigation of endpoint, network, identity, email, cloud, and application security alerts.
* Develop hypothesis-driven threat hunts using SIEM, EDR/XDR, firewall, DNS, proxy, authentication, and vulnerability data; document evidence, conclusions, and follow-up actions.
* Engineer, tune, and validate detections to improve fidelity, reduce false positives, and map coverage to MITRE ATT&CK techniques.
* Build investigation workflows and queries for suspicious authentication, lateral movement, command execution, persistence, data staging, beaconing, and exfiltration behaviors.
* Perform incident command or technical-lead duties for major events and coordinate evidence preservation, containment, recovery, and post-incident improvements.
* Must have good experience in using LLM’s for security posture improvements.
  

**Network, Endpoint & Identity Security**

* Provide senior technical support for firewalls, IPS/IDS, endpoint protection, EDR/XDR, secure remote access, network security monitoring, and security analytics platforms.
* Review network security policies and security profiles using least privilege, risk, business context, and change-control requirements.
* Investigate anomalous remote access, privileged activity, service-account use, account lifecycle events, and unusual east-west or outbound traffic.
* Partner with infrastructure and platform teams to validate remediation, compensating controls, and residual risk.
  

**Application Security & Penetration Testing**

* Plan and execute authorized penetration tests of web applications, APIs, and supporting infrastructure; define scope, rules of engagement, evidence handling, and retest criteria.
* Assess common application and API weaknesses using OWASP Top 10, OWASP API Security Top 10, threat modeling, secure design review, and manual testing techniques.
* Advise product and engineering teams on practical placement and use of SAST, DAST, software composition analysis, secrets scanning, container scanning, and infrastructure-as-code scanning within the SDLC.
* Validate exploitability, business impact, attack paths, and remediation effectiveness; produce clear technical findings and executive summaries.
* Facilitate threat-modeling sessions covering assets, trust boundaries, abuse cases, security controls, and residual risks before significant releases or architectural changes.

  

**Vulnerability & Exposure Management**

* Lead risk-based prioritization using exploitability, asset criticality, internet exposure, active exploitation, compensating controls, and business impact rather than severity score alone.
* Coordinate remediation and exception workflows with asset owners; validate closure through rescanning, configuration review, or technical retesting.
* Analyze recurring weaknesses and control gaps, and recommend preventive actions across configuration, patching, architecture, and secure development practices.

  

**Automation, Engineering & Operational Excellence**

* Automate repeatable analysis, enrichment, reporting, and response activities using scripting, APIs, SOAR, reusable templates, and version-controlled content.
* Maintain runbooks, detection documentation, architecture diagrams, integration details, operational procedures, and knowledge-transfer materials.
* Define meaningful operational measures for detection coverage, investigation quality, response, remediation ageing, recurrence, and control effectiveness.
* Evaluate security tooling and integrations through structured testing, operational fit, telemetry quality, scalability, and maintainability.
  

**Technical Leadership & Representation**

* Act as a technical delegate for the Manager – Security Operations in operational reviews, incident forums, architecture discussions, audits, and cross-functional meetings.
* Provide clear risk-based recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders without overstating certainty or impact.
* Mentor analysts and engineers through case reviews, hunt development, detection engineering, application security, and incident-response exercises.
* Coordinate effectively across regions and time zones and participate in the 24x7 on-call rotation as required.

  

**Required Qualifications**

* Experience with SentinelOne or a comparable EDR/XDR platform; Splunk or a comparable SIEM; Fortinet/FortiGate/FortiAnalyzer or comparable network security technologies; and enterprise vulnerability-management platforms.
* Experience securing cloud, container, Kubernetes, DevSecOps, and infrastructure-as-code environments.
* Experience conducting forensic analysis, purple-team exercises, attack-path analysis, or adversary emulation in authorized environments.
* Relevant certifications such as CISSP, GIAC (GCIH, GCIA, GPEN), OSCP/OSWE, CREST, or cloud-security certifications. Certifications are valued as supporting evidence, not a substitute for demonstrated hands-on capability.
* Experience supporting globally distributed teams and regulated or high-availability environments.
  

**Education And/Or Qualification:**

* 13 to 15 years of progressive cybersecurity or closely related engineering experience, including at least 5 years in security operations, incident response, detection engineering, or threat hunting.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience leading complex security investigations and communicating evidence, risk, decisions, and remediation actions.
* Practical experience with SIEM and EDR/XDR platforms, firewall or network security telemetry, identity and authentication logs, vulnerability scanners, and ticket or case-management workflows.
* Hands-on web application and API penetration-testing experience, including manual validation and clear reporting of reproducible findings.
* Strong understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, TLS, authentication, Windows and Linux security, Active Directory or modern identity platforms, and cloud security fundamentals.
* Experience with vulnerability and exposure management, risk-based prioritization, remediation validation, and exception governance.
* Working knowledge of secure SDLC controls, SAST, DAST, software composition analysis, secrets management, threat modeling, and CI/CD security integration.
* Proficiency in at least one scripting or query language used for security analysis or automation, such as Python, PowerShell, Bash, SPL, KQL, SQL, or a platform-specific query language.
* Ability to lead technical discussions, mentor team members, manage competing priorities, and operate effectively during high-pressure incidents.
* Must have experience in effectively using AI models for Security operations and security posture development.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills, including executive-ready summaries and technically precise documentation.

  

**Leadership Behaviors**

* Hands-on ownership: moves from alert or finding to evidence-based conclusion and verified remediation.
* Judgment: distinguishes true risk from technical noise and makes proportionate recommendations.
* Collaboration: challenges constructively, listens to operational constraints, and builds agreement around secure outcomes.
* Communication: adapts depth and language for analysts, engineers, product teams, auditors, and executives.
* Learning mindset: stays current, tests assumptions, shares knowledge, and continuously improves controls and team capability.
  

**Interview Evidence to Validate**

Candidates should be assessed through practical evidence rather than tool-name familiarity alone. The interview process should validate:

* A structured investigation of a multi-source security incident using endpoint, firewall, identity, DNS, and application evidence.
* A threat-hunting scenario requiring a hypothesis, queries, exclusions, validation steps, and a defensible conclusion.
* A web application or API security scenario covering attack surface, testing approach, exploitability, remediation, and retesting.
* A detection-tuning exercise that balances coverage, false positives, and operational impact.
* An example of leading remediation across teams when ownership, business impact, or exception requirements are contested.
* Ability to brief the same issue to both engineers and senior leadership.
  

**Work Requirements**

* Participate in an on-call rotation and perform after-hours work when required for major incidents, critical changes, or global operational needs.
* Comply with applicable HID Global policies and procedures related to quality, security, safety, business continuity, privacy, and environmental systems.
* Perform only formally authorized security testing and follow approved scope, evidence-handling, and disclosure requirements.
* Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals to perform the essential functions of the role.
  

**Document note:** This revision positions the role as a senior hands-on lead with balanced depth across SOC operations, threat hunting, incident response, network and identity security, vulnerability management, application security, penetration testing, automation, and stakeholder representation.

  

**Why apply?**

* **Empowerment:** You’ll work as part of a global team in a flexible work environment, learning and enhancing your expertise. We welcome an opportunity to meet you and learn about your unique talents, skills, and experiences. You don’t need to check all the boxes. If you have most of the skills and experience, we want you to apply.
* **Innovation:** You embrace challenges and want to drive change. We are open to ideas, including flexible work arrangements, job sharing or part-time job seekers.
* **Integrity:** You are results-orientated, reliable, and straightforward and value being treated accordingly. We want all our employees to be themselves, to feel appreciated and accepted.

This opportunity may be open to flexible working arrangements.

HID is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer – Minority/Female/Disability/Veteran/Gender Identity/Sexual Orientation.

**We make it easier for people to get where they want to go!**
  
On an average day, think of how many times you tap, twist, tag, push or swipe to get access, find information, connect with others or track something. HID technology is behind billions of interactions, in more than 100 countries. We help you create a verified, trusted identity that can get you where you need to go – without having to think about it.
  
  
When you join our HID team, you’ll also be part of the ASSA ABLOY Group, the global leader in access solutions. You’ll have 63,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally. As we welcome new people on board, it’s important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences.

title: Sr. Major Incident Management Engineer - ROPS
description:
Job Title: ITSM Service Manager

  
  

Location: Chennai, TN.

  
  

Employment Type: Full-Time / Contract

  
  

About the Role

  
  

The ITSM Service Manager is primarily responsible for the strategic design, implementation, and continual improvement of IT Service Management (ITSM) processes across the enterprise. Acting as the champion of ITIL best practices, this role ensures IT services meet agreed-upon Service Level Agreements (SLAs), governs the ITSM platform (e.g., ServiceNow), and drives a culture of high-quality, customer-centric IT support.

  
  

As an additional core responsibility, this role provides operational oversight to the Network Operations Center (NOC). By integrating ITSM governance directly with NOC operations, the manager will ensure that event monitoring, alert tuning, and Tier 1/2 escalation workflows perfectly align with the organization's broader Incident, Problem, and Change Management frameworks.

  
  

Key Responsibilities

  
  

1. ITSM Process Governance & Strategy (Primary)

  
  

Process Ownership: Serve as the enterprise process owner for Incident, Problem, Change, Release, Request, and Knowledge Management.

  
  

Continual Service Improvement (CSI): Analyze existing IT workflows, identify bottlenecks, and implement data-driven process improvements.

  
  

Platform Optimization: Partner with ITSM developers to ensure the platform (e.g., ServiceNow) is optimized, automated, and accurately reflects process requirements.

  
  

Service Catalog & CMDB: Maintain the IT Service Catalog and oversee Configuration Management Database (CMDB) accuracy, ensuring CI dependencies are mapped for accurate impact analysis.

  
  

2. Major Incident, Problem & Change Leadership (Primary)

  
  

Major Incident Commander: Act as the ultimate escalation point for Severity 1/2 incidents. Coordinate cross-functional technical teams (including the NOC) to restore services rapidly, managing war rooms and executive communications.

  
  

Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Drive the Problem Management lifecycle by ensuring post-incident reviews (PIRs) are completed and permanent fixes are tracked and implemented.

  
  

Change Advisory Board (CAB): Chair the CAB, rigorously evaluating the risk, impact, and operational readiness of all proposed infrastructure and application changes.

  
  

3. Service Level & Performance Management (Primary)

  
  

SLA/OLA Management: Negotiate and enforce Service Level Agreements (SLAs) with business units and Operational Level Agreements (OLAs) between support tiers.

  
  

Metrics & Dashboards: Design and publish executive reporting on ITSM and IT operations KPIs (e.g., Mean Time to Resolve [MTTR], First Contact Resolution [FCR], Change Success Rate).

  
  

Vendor Governance: Monitor third-party managed service providers and software vendors to ensure compliance with contracted SLAs.

  
  

4. NOC Oversight & Event Management (Additional)

  
  

Operational Alignment: Oversee the NOC's daily operations to ensure monitoring, event detection, and initial triage strictly adhere to defined ITSM processes.

  
  

Alert-to-Incident Workflow: Guide the tuning of enterprise monitoring tools (e.g., SolarWinds, Datadog) to reduce alert noise and automate incident creation for actionable events.

  
  

Escalation Pathways: Develop and maintain runbooks, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and escalation matrices for the NOC to ensure seamless handoffs to Tier 3 engineering.

  
  

Team Guidance: Provide matrix leadership or direct oversight to NOC shift leads, ensuring 24/7 coverage maintains high standards of responsiveness and communication.

  
  

Qualifications & Experience

  
  

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field.

  
  

Experience: 6 to 8+ years of progressive experience in IT Operations, with a minimum of 4 years dedicated to ITSM process ownership or service delivery. Includes at least 2 years of experience overseeing, interacting with, or managing a NOC/Command Center environment.

  
  

ITSM Expertise: Deep, hands-on experience managing enterprise ITSM platforms (ServiceNow strongly preferred; Cherwell, Jira Service Management, or BMC Helix accepted).

  
  

Monitoring Acumen: Familiarity with enterprise monitoring concepts and ITOM tools (e.g., Splunk, Datadog, SolarWinds, LogicMonitor) to effectively guide NOC event management.

  
  

Certifications

  
  

Required: ITIL v4 Foundation Certification.

  
  

Preferred: ITIL v4 Managing Professional (MP) or ITIL v4 Create, Deliver and Support.

  
  

Bonus: Basic networking or cloud certifications (e.g., AWS Cloud Practitioner, CompTIA Network+) to aid in NOC technical communication.

  
  

Core Competencies

  
  

Strategic & Process-Oriented: Exceptional ability to design theoretical frameworks and translate them into practical, daily habits for technical teams.

  
  

Crisis Management: Highly structured, calm, and authoritative when leading major incident war rooms.

  
  

Bridge-Builder: Skilled at bridging the gap between high-level business requirements (ITSM) and deeply technical, rapid-response execution (NOC).

  
  

Analytical Decision Making: Highly proficient in interpreting ITSM and monitoring data to justify process changes or infrastructure investments.

title: Software Principal Engineer
description:
**Principal Software Engineer – System Test & Validation (SONiC AI & Enterprise Networking)**

**Infrastructure Solutions Group (ISG)** builds the products that power infrastructure, solutions, and data management our customers need most. Our teams design and develop the hardware and software that connect infrastructure, accelerate computational workloads, integrate across the stack, protect data continuity, and deliver the platforms, applications, and diagnostics our customers rely on every day at enterprise scale.

**Some product builders follow the rules. Ours rewrite them.**

Within ISG, innovation isn't just about creating new technology- it's about challenging assumptions and reimagining how work gets done. Engineers define intent, author precise specifications, and orchestrate AI agents that execute at speed and scale. AI is embedded throughout our development process, helping us move faster, learn quicker, and deliver greater impact. Yet the most important contribution remains uniquely human: deciding what to build, designing how it should work, and applying the judgment needed to earn our customers' trust. When your products power critical infrastructure around the world, that responsibility matters.

We move quickly toward the work that matters most. We reward experimentation, encourage bold thinking, and remove unnecessary barriers so great ideas can become reality faster. Our teams embrace a customer-first, first-to-market mindset, transforming rapid feedback into better products and better outcomes. We aren't looking for people who are content with the status quo- we look for builders who question it, improve it, and occasionally rewrite it.

If you're energized by solving complex systems challenges, excited to work alongside AI to amplify your impact, and motivated by the opportunity to shape what's next instead of simply maintaining what's been done before, you'll find your place here.

Join us to do the best work of your career and make a profound social impact as a Principal Software Engineer on our System Test Engineering Team in Chennai, India.

**What you’ll achieve**

As a Principal Software Engineer, you will be responsible for system and solution-level validation of SONiC-based AI and enterprise networking platforms, from test strategy and automation through root-cause analysis. As a successful candidate, you will be a technically savvy, passionate, and strongly self-driven engineer who drives the deliverables and objectives entrusted to you, your team, and scrums, working with engineering and architecture teams on customer use-case and solution-centric validation at multidimensional scale across complex rack-scale networking and compute deployments. Hiring at the Principal Software Engineer level or below, based on technical expertise, experience, and demonstrated impact.

**You will:**

* Design and execute system and solution-level validation, translating product requirements, architecture documents, and specifications into comprehensive test plans and cases aligned with spec-driven and test-driven development (SDD/TDD).
* Validate use-case and solution-centric functional, performance, resiliency, interoperability, and end-to-end scenarios at multidimensional scale, including RoCE and lossless-fabric behavior under congestion (PFC, ECN, link-level retransmission, and retransmits).
* Track link-level health across test runs and releases, including error counters, link flaps, and FEC and CRC trends.
* Build and improve Python and SpyTest automation and AI agents that improve execution efficiency, impact, and value, accelerating CI/CD pipelines and test coverage.
* Analyze logs, telemetry, packet captures, and system behavior to identify root causes, close field escapes, and resolve complex issues through triage and closure.

**Take the first step towards your dream career**

Every Dell Technologies team member brings something unique to the table. Here’s what we are looking for with this role:

**Essential Requirements**

* System and solution validation: system testing and end-to-end validation of AI, data center, and enterprise networking solutions at multidimensional scale, including troubleshooting complex scale-up, scale-across, scale-out, and rack-scale networking and compute deployments.
* Networking technologies: VXLAN-EVPN, MLAG, EVPN-MH, ECMP, VRF, BGP, OSPF, IS-IS, SRv6, BFD, VLAN, LACP, LLDP, STP, multicast, and network services (DHCP, DNS, NTP, LDAP, RADIUS, TACACS+, 802.1X).
* AI fabric performance: RoCE, QoS, DCB (PFC/ECN), lossless Ethernet, link-level retransmission, latency, performance, and resiliency, including collective-communication traffic on GPU clusters.
* Automation and telemetry: strong Python and test automation skills, with automation frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, validation at scale, telemetry and northbound interfaces (CLI, REST, gNMI, NETCONF/YANG), packet analysis, and traffic generator testing (for example IXIA).
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering in CSE, ECE, EEE, IT, Computer Networks, Cloud Computing, or equivalent.

**Desirable Requirements**

* Hands-on SpyTest and network test automation, spec-driven or test-driven development (SDD/TDD), familiarity with server and storage environments, and data analysis for trend and escape analysis (SQL, pandas).
* Experience building or using AI agents and AI-assisted workflows (AI models and tools, for example Claude, Devin, GitHub Copilot) for test development, automation, analysis, and troubleshooting, and exposure to emerging scale-up fabric standards (for example UALink and Ultra Ethernet).  
    
  **Application closing date: 16/11/2026.**

**Who We Are**

We believe that each of us has the power to make an impact. That’s why we put our team members at the center of everything we do. If you’re looking for an opportunity to grow your career with some of the best minds and most advanced tech in the industry, we’re looking for you.

Dell Technologies is a unique family of businesses that helps individuals and organizations transform how they work, live and play. Join us to build a future that works for everyone because Progress Takes All of Us.  
  
Dell Technologies is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. **Read the full Equal Employment Opportunity Policy**.

Visit our ***Culture Code*** page to learn more about how we work and lead.

description:
Job Description

Senior Security Architect

**. Solution Architecture and Design**
======================================

* Lead the architecture and design of large, complex and multi-technology solutions aligned to customer business and technical requirements.
* Translate business, functional and non-functional requirements into coherent end-to-end solution architectures.
* Produce and govern High-Level Designs, Low-Level Designs, Solution Architecture Documents, reference architectures, architecture decision records and implementation patterns.
* Ensure solutions address security, scalability, availability, resilience, performance, manageability, interoperability and supportability.
* Define integration across cloud, infrastructure, applications, networks, security, data and operational service components.
* Assess current-state environments and develop target-state architectures, transformation approaches and technology roadmaps.
* Identify architectural risks, constraints, assumptions, dependencies and technical debt; evaluate options and articulate trade-offs.

**2. Customer Consulting and Advisory**
=======================================

* Act as a trusted technology advisor to customer architects, engineering leaders, CIO, CTO and CISO organizations, and business stakeholders.
* Lead discovery sessions, architecture workshops, assessments and design reviews.
* Translate customer objectives into practical technology outcomes and communicate complex concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Provide recommendations for modernization, transformation, optimization, risk reduction and service improvement.
* Build strong customer relationships and positively influence strategic technology decisions.

**3. Pre-Sales and Solution Development**
=========================================

* Provide architectural leadership for RFI, RFP and RFQ responses, bids and strategic opportunities.
* Support sales and account teams throughout opportunity qualification and solution development.
* Develop solution architectures, technical proposals, Statements of Work, assumptions, dependencies and solution narratives.
* Produce effort estimates, Bills of Materials, licensing assumptions and technical inputs to commercial models.
* Lead customer presentations, solution workshops, demonstrations and technical defence sessions.
* Ensure proposed solutions are technically achievable, operationally supportable and commercially viable.

**4. Technical and Delivery Governance**
========================================

* Serve as design authority throughout the solution lifecycle and govern implementation against the approved architecture.
* Conduct design assurance and technical reviews at defined architecture and delivery gates.
* Manage architecture decisions, technical risks, exceptions, constraints and dependencies.
* Support delivery teams in resolving complex architecture and integration issues.
* Define solution acceptance criteria and contribute to testing, transition and operational readiness.
* Maintain appropriate documentation, traceability and architecture governance.

**5. Technology Leadership**
============================

The successful candidate should demonstrate sound architecture knowledge across several of the following domains:

**Domain**

**Expected capability**

  

**Cloud**

Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services and/or Google Cloud Platform

  

**Infrastructure**

Compute, storage, virtualization, backup and platform services

  

**Networking**

Enterprise networking, SD-WAN, DNS/DHCP, load balancing and connectivity

  

**Security**

Zero Trust, identity and access management, endpoint, network and cloud security

  

**Applications**

Application modernization, APIs, middleware and integration architecture

  

**Data**

Data platforms, integration, governance and cloud data services

  

**Automation**

Infrastructure as Code, DevOps, CI/CD and orchestration

  

**Operations**

ITSM, monitoring, observability, service management and operational readiness

  

**Emerging technology**

AI, generative AI, automation and modern digital platforms

**6. Security by Design**
=========================

* Embed security into the architecture from initial design rather than treating it as a downstream activity.
* Align solutions with enterprise security standards, regulatory requirements and customer policies.
* Incorporate identity, privileged access, encryption, logging, monitoring, vulnerability management, network segmentation and data protection controls.
* Collaborate with specialist cybersecurity architects where deeper domain expertise is required.
* Apply appropriate risk assessment and threat-modelling techniques for critical solutions.

**7. Architecture Leadership and Mentoring**
============================================

* Provide technical direction to solution architects, domain architects, consultants and engineers.
* Coordinate multidisciplinary teams contributing to complex solutions and review their architecture deliverables.
* Mentor junior and intermediate architects and promote consistent architecture practices.
* Support the development of architecture capability, communities of practice and technical standards.

**8. Innovation and Reusable Intellectual Property**
====================================================

* Develop reusable reference architectures, patterns, templates, blueprints and accelerators.
* Contribute lessons learned and delivery experience to Fujitsu knowledge repositories.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and assess their applicability to customer requirements.
* Participate in architecture communities, technology forums and thought-leadership activities.
* Collaborate with strategic technology partners to enhance Fujitsu solution offerings.

**Required Experience**
=======================

* 15+ years of relevant IT experience, including approximately 8+ years in solution, technical or enterprise architecture.
* Proven experience architecting large-scale enterprise technology solutions across multiple technology domains.
* Demonstrated customer-facing consulting, workshop facilitation and stakeholder-management experience.
* Strong understanding of architecture principles, integration patterns and non-functional requirements.
* Experience producing HLDs, LLDs, architecture documents, technical proposals and implementation roadmaps.
* Previous involvement in RFPs, proposals, solution estimation and pre-sales activities.
* Experience leading multidisciplinary engineering and delivery teams.
* Ability to evaluate solutions from business, technical, security, risk, operational and commercial perspectives.

**Professional Competencies**
=============================

* Architecture leadership: ownership of complex end-to-end architecture and design decisions.
* Customer focus: ability to understand desired business outcomes rather than proposing technology in isolation.
* Commercial awareness: understanding of solution cost, effort, risk and architectural trade-offs.
* Communication: excellent written, verbal, workshop-facilitation and presentation skills.
* Problem solving: a structured, evidence-based approach to complex business and technical challenges.
* Stakeholder management: confidence working with customer executives, architects, vendors and delivery teams.
* Collaboration and leadership: ability to influence geographically distributed and multidisciplinary teams without relying solely on formal authority.

**Qualifications and Certifications**
=====================================

**Education**
-------------

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* A master's degree or postgraduate business or technology qualification is advantageous.

**Preferred Certifications**
----------------------------

Candidates are not expected to hold every certification. Relevant credentials may include:

* CISSP and/or CCSP
* TOGAF
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert
* Microsoft Certified: Cybersecurity Architect
* AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Professional
* ITIL
* Relevant technology or domain certifications aligned to the candidate's specialization.

**Key Success Measures**
========================

* Quality, completeness and approval of architecture deliverables and design assurance.
* Customer satisfaction, stakeholder confidence and demonstrable influence on outcomes.
* Successful delivery against agreed scope, quality, cost and timelines.
* Technical contribution to proposals, competitive wins and business growth.
* Effective identification and management of architecture and delivery risk.
* Adoption of reusable architecture patterns and accelerators.
* Contribution to architecture communities, knowledge sharing and colleague development.

### **Tech innovators**

### **Challenge seekers**

Your unique perspectives make our ambitions and capabilities possible. Our culture of sharing ideas, learning and improving together helps us consistently set the bar higher. As a proactive collaborator, you'll seek out ways to bring people together to achieve their best.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

**Job ID** R-263574 **Date posted** 11/09/2026

**Job Title: Lead Engineer - CMBD, Discovery & Integration**
------------------------------------------------------------

**GCL: E**
----------

**Introduction to role:**
-------------------------

Are you ready to own and elevate the ServiceNow CMDB that underpins operational resilience, security, and speed at a global scale? This is a rare opportunity to lead the technical spine of our digital enterprise—Discovery, Service Mapping, CSDM and integrations—so our teams can deliver life-changing medicines with confidence and pace.

In this role, you will set the standards, solve complex data and modeling challenges, and guide engineering teams to deliver a trusted, consolidated source of configuration truth. You will work across platform, cloud, security, infrastructure and application groups to ensure configuration data is accurate, transparent and actionable. Can you picture yourself diagnosing critical issues in minutes, enabling faster incident response, seamless change, and stronger risk decisions for thousands of colleagues worldwide?

**Accountabilities:**
---------------------

* Act as the technical authority for CI classes, attributes, and relationships. Optimize IRE rules and reconciliation precedence. Maintain a single, reconciled source of truth. Use CMDB Health, the 360-degree CMDB view, and the Data Manager tool to improve data quality continuously.
* Discovery and Service Mapping Skills: Build, provide, and resolve issues in asset identification and the visualization of services for both on-premises and cloud environments, adjusting schedules, MID Servers, credentials, ranges, and patterns to improve coverage, precision, and dependability of application-to-infrastructure connections.
* CSDM Modelling and Implementation: Define and socialize modeling patterns across Business Applications, Application and Business Services, Technical Services and Service Offerings; remediate legacy models and embed consistent, standards-based onboarding.
* CMDB Integrations and Data Controls: Engineer robust Service Graph and IntegrationHub ETL integrations for cloud, endpoint, security and network sources; normalize and reconcile data across APIs, transforms and IRE with clear monitoring, exception handling and data-quality controls.
