Employment Type: Full Time  
Education Qualification: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field or higher with minimum 06 years of relevant experience  
  
Job Summary  
Experience Required: 6–9+ Years  
  
Job Summary  
We are seeking a high caliber Senior AS/400 (IBM i) Systems Administrator / Infrastructure Engineer (L3 Support) to serve as the senior technical authority for our enterprise IBM Power Systems platform. In this lead engineering role, you will be responsible for platform architecture, operating system upgrades, virtualization design, deep tier incident forensics, high availability/disaster recovery (HA/DR) design, storage engineering, and performance optimization.  
The successful candidate will act as the final internal escalation tier for mission critical IBM i infrastructure incidents, drive complex OS migrations across releases (IBM i 7.3, 7.4, and 7.5), architect PowerVM and VIOS environments, optimize enterprise storage configurations (IASP, SAN integration), and orchestrate automated HA/DR replication architectures (PowerHA, MIMIX). This role focuses purely on system architecture, operating system engineering, security hardening, and infrastructure resilience, serving as the technical liaison to IBM Support (PMR/Escalations), enterprise architects, and executive IT management.  
  
  
Key Responsibilities  
1. Level 3 Escalation, Deep Diagnostics & Root Cause Analysis (RCA)  
  
. Serve as the supreme technical escalation authority for severe (P1/Major) system outages, abnormal IPLs, kernel exceptions, hung partitions, and machine check conditions.  
. Conduct advanced system crash investigations using System Service Tools (SST), Dedicated Service Tools (DST), Main Storage Dumps (MSD), and LIC trace analysis.  
. Interrogate advanced logs (PAL, QHST, Advanced Job Logs) to diagnose complex intermittent hardware faults, bus channel errors, and memory corruptions.  
. Own and author definitive Root Cause Analysis (RCA) documentation; engineer preventative architecture changes to permanently eliminate systemic failure modes.  
. Manage and drive complex technical support cases (PMRs / IBM Support Cases), coordinating directly with IBM Level 3 labs and Rochester development teams.  
  
2. Operating System Lifecycle, Version Migrations & PTF Engineering  
  
. Architect, plan, and execute major OS release upgrades (e.g., migrations from IBM i 7.3/7.4 to 7.5) and Technology Refresh (TR) cycles across large scale enterprise estates.  
. Formulate comprehensive PTF management policies; perform cross subsystem prerequisite/corequisite analysis, microcode/firmware compatibility matrices, and regression risk assessments.  
. Manage system level configurations including dynamic tuning system values, Workload Groups, Subsystem Descriptions (SBSD), Class parameters, and memory pool allocations.  
. Oversee system initialization scripts, startup programs (QSTRUP), subsystem routing architectures, and operational configurations.  
  
3. Power Systems Architecture, PowerVM & VIOS Engineering  
  
. Architect, configure, and maintain enterprise IBM Power Systems hardware (Power9, Power10) managed via redundant Hardware Management Consoles (HMC).  
. Design and implement PowerVM virtualization solutions, including Virtual I/O Server (VIOS) clustering, Shared Ethernet Adapter (SEA) failover, and N\_Port ID Virtualization (NPIV) SAN mapping.  
. Engineer enterprise LPAR topology, configuring shared processor pools, capped/uncapped partitions, Virtual Processors, and dynamic processor/memory optimization.  
. Lead HMC firmware lifecycles, service processor firmware upgrades, and disaster recovery replication for HMC configurations.  
  
4. Enterprise HA/DR Architecture & Disaster Recovery Orchestration  
  
. Design, implement, and fine tune enterprise High Availability (HA) replication architectures using solutions such as Precisely MIMIX, IBM PowerHA SystemMirror, or Maxava HA.  
. Architect journal environments: Remote Journaling (RJ), asynchronous/synchronous network transport, dual journal receivers, and threshold management.  
. Architect and lead scheduled enterprise Disaster Recovery (DR) and full role swap (switchover / failover) tests, guaranteeing stringent Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPO).  
. Develop and maintain automated failover scripts, audit validation procedures, and emergency split brain recovery playbooks.  
  
5. Storage Engineering, IASP & Resiliency Architecture  
  
. Architect auxiliary storage topologies, balancing internal NVMe/SAS drives and external SAN arrays (IBM FlashSystem, DS8000) using San Volume Controller (SVC).  
. Implement and manage Independent Auxiliary Storage Pools (IASP) to isolate databases for modular switchover and flash copy operations.  
. Formulate enterprise wide BRMS (Backup, Recovery, and Media Services) architecture, including network synced BRMS clusters, media lifecycle policies, and VTL encryption.  
. Author and validate bare metal disaster recovery procedures, cold start installation plans, and full scale recovery runs (SAVSYS / Option 21 rebuilds).  
  
6. Advanced Performance Tuning, Profiling & Capacity Planning  
  
. Conduct deep tier system performance profiling utilizing IBM i Performance Data Investigator (PDI), Collection Services, Job Watcher, Disk Watcher, and IBM i Doctor.  
. Optimize system memory allocation by tuning dynamic system values (QPFRADJ), defining private memory pools, and resolving object lock contention.  
. Analyze disk subsystem bottlenecks, arm contention, queue depths, and optimize paging space allocation.  
. Formulate multi year capacity planning models predicting CPU (CPW), memory, and SAN storage expansion aligned with corporate business growth.  
  
7. Security Hardening, Audit Forensics & Compliance Architecture  
  
. Architect and enforce OS security hardening in accordance with IBM i Security Level 40 and 50 standards.  
. Establish comprehensive security auditing architectures via QAUDJRN, configuring journal filters for security critical actions and unauthorized object manipulation.  
. Implement adopted authority controls, secure system values (QSECURITY, QPWD\*, QALWUSRDMN), and service program access controls.  
. Drive compliance and vulnerability management programs (SOX, PCI DSS, ISO 27001), designing automated scripts to remediate non compliant configurations.  
  
8. Infrastructure Automation, Modernization & Technical Mentorship  
  
. Architect reusable operational automation utilizing advanced Control Language (CL) programs and modern Db2 for i / IBM i Services (QSYS2).  
. Evaluate and implement modern administration frameworks, such as IBM i open source integration (PASE, Bash, Python), Ansible for IBM i automation, and REST APIs.  
. Serve as the technical mentor and escalation lead for L1 and L2 system administrators, conducting peer technical reviews and establishing enterprise engineering standards.  
. Participate in architectural review boards (ARB) for major business applications and enterprise infrastructure projects.  
  
Key skills :  
Backup strategies, disaster  
Recovery plans  
Performance tuning,  
Capacity/resource planning  
Data Restoration  
System Upgrades  
  
  
Required Qualifications  
  
. Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent industry experience.  
. Experience: Minimum of 6–10+ years of dedicated, hands on enterprise experience in IBM i (AS/400) System Engineering, Power Systems Architecture, and L3 Support.  
. Environment Experience: Proven track record architecting and supporting large scale enterprise environments (30+ LPARs, multi system Power9/Power10 estates, petabyte scale storage, and critical transaction banking/retail/logistics systems).  
  
  
Required Technical Skills  
  
. Operating System Mastery: Deep internal architecture knowledge of IBM i (releases 7.2 through 7.5), LIC, SLIC, Microcode, Machine Check handling, and SST/DST forensics.  
. OS Migration & Lifecycle: Proven leadership in executing complex OS release upgrades (e.g., 7.3 > 7.4 > 7.5) and comprehensive Technology Refresh (TR) deployments.  
. Hardware & Virtualization: Advanced architecture experience with IBM Power9/Power10, redundant HMCs, PowerVM, dual VIOS configurations, NPIV, SEA, and dynamic LPAR allocation.  
. High Availability & DR: Mastery of enterprise HA solutions: MIMIX or PowerHA SystemMirror; comprehensive design of Remote Journals, data synchronization engines, and full site to site role swaps.  
. Storage & Resiliency: Architecture of IASP, SAN attached storage (SVC/FlashSystem), Multipath I/O, bare metal restore procedures, and enterprise wide BRMS network cluster management.  
. Deep Diagnostics & Performance: Proficiency with Collection Services, Performance Tools (PT1), PDI, Job Watcher, Disk Watcher, IBM i Doctor, and MSD analysis.  
. Security & Auditing: Security Level 40/50 enforcement, deep QAUDJRN forensics, authorization list architecture, and audit remediation.  
. Automation: Advanced CL programming, complex QSYS2 / Db2 for i SQL Services, and exposure to Ansible for IBM i or shell scripting.  
. Service Frameworks: Mature understanding of ITIL Problem Management, Change Governance, and Architectural Standards.  
  
  
Preferred Qualifications  
  
. IBM Certified System Administrator / Solution Architect – IBM i.  
. Certified High Availability Professional (e.g., Precisely Certified MIMIX Professional).  
. Direct experience architecting IBM i within Hybrid Cloud environments (e.g., IBM Power Virtual Server / PowerVS on IBM Cloud).  
. Deep experience in Ansible automation for IBM i system administration.  
. ITIL Intermediate or Expert Certification.  
  
  
Key Competencies  
  
. Masterful Diagnostic Mindset: Exceptional ability to deconstruct complex, multi tiered infrastructure failures spanning OS, hypervisor, SAN, network, and application code.  
. Decisive Crisis Leadership: Ability to take total technical command during critical production outages and execute high risk recovery actions under executive visibility.  
. Strategic Infrastructure Vision: Capacity to balance immediate operational reliability with multi year modernization and platform automation goals.  
. Technical Mentorship & Advocacy: Passion for uplifting team capabilities, mentoring L2 engineers, and evangelizing modern IBM i administrative patterns.e zones.boration with global engineering teams and operational hubs across multiple time zones.

* **Anchor Technical Delivery:** Act as the primary technical anchor, translating complex business requirements from legacy applications in GDIA into scalable, fault-tolerant system designs, architectural blueprints, and execution roadmaps.

* **Legacy System Modernization:** Lead legacy modernization initiatives by re-architecting monolithic services into modular, containerized workloads on GCP, engineering continuous ingestion flows from heterogeneous enterprise platforms.
* **Engineering Mentorship & SDLC Excellence:** Champion agile engineering best practices, enforce test-driven development (TDD), lead comprehensive code reviews, and mentor engineers across full-stack, data engineering, and cloud domains.

### **2. Full-Stack & Microservices Engineering**

* **Backend Services:** Architect and develop robust, high-performance microservices and RESTful APIs using Java 17+, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, and supporting synchronous transactions and asynchronous event-driven flows.
* **Frontend & Data Visualization:** Build responsive, user-centric interfaces using Angular, React, and Node.js that integrate seamlessly with backend APIs to deliver intuitive self-service data access, reporting, and interactive data visualization.
* **API Gateway & Service Mesh:** Design and standardize API gateway topologies using Apigee; enforce service discovery, circuit breakers, rate limiting, and resilient inter-service communication.
* **Performance Engineering & Optimization:** Profile and optimize distributed systems end-to-end, including JVM tuning, connection pooling, caching strategies, and database query tuning across relational (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL datastores.

### **3. Cloud Data Engineering & Analytics**

* **Scalable Data Pipelines:** Architect, build, and maintain real-time streaming and high-volume batch data pipelines leveraging GCP Dataflow (Apache Beam), Dataproc (Spark/Hadoop), and Cloud Pub/Sub.
* **Modern Data Warehousing:** Standardize, model, partition, and optimize enterprise datasets within Google BigQuery to ensure exceptional SQL query performance, cost efficiency, and real-time analytical capabilities.

### **4. Security, Governance & Compliance**

* **Zero Trust Security:** Enforce least-privileged access control across applications, integrating Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), ADFS, OAuth2/OIDC, and method-level access authorization.
* **Cloud & Data Governance:** Implement robust cloud security frameworks, including Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), data encryption (in transit and at rest), data masking, and GCP-native row-level and column-level security.
* **Regulatory Compliance:** Partner with cybersecurity, compliance, and governance teams to maintain adherence to enterprise data privacy mandates and corporate security standards.

### **5. DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure & Observability**

* **Infrastructure as Code (IaC):** Automate and manage repeatable cloud infrastructure and platform provisioning using Terraform.
* **CI/CD Automation:** Design and optimize enterprise CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Tekton, and build automation tools (Maven, Gradle) for automated testing, static code analysis, and zero-downtime deployments.
* **Operational Reliability & Telemetry:** Establish proactive monitoring, tracing, and alerting frameworks across Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), Cloud Run, and Cloud Functions to diagnose distributed system bottlenecks and ensure platform health.
* **AI/ML Innovation:** Apply foundational AI and Machine Learning (ML) concepts, including Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs), to accelerate engineering workflows and enhance software capabilities.

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent practical experience).

* **Backend Engineering:** Deep expertise in **Java (Java 17+)**, **Spring Ecosystem** (Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Spring Data, Spring Security), and scripting proficiency.
* **Frontend Engineering:** Hands-on experience developing data visualization and exploration interfaces using **React**, **Angular**, or **Node.js**.
* **GCP Cloud Platforms:** Proven track record architecting and deploying systems on **Google Cloud Platform (GCP)**, specifically **BigQuery**, **Cloud Run**, **GKE** and **Cloud Pub/Sub**.
* **Database Systems:** Strong practical expertise with relational databases (**PostgreSQL**, **MySQL**), NoSQL datastores, and columnar analytical warehouses.
* **DevOps & IaC:** Hands-on mastery of Infrastructure as Code using **Terraform**, containerization (**Docker**, **Kubernetes**), and automated CI/CD tools (**GitHub Actions**, **Tekton**, **Maven/Gradle**).
* **API & Testing Standards:** Deep knowledge of RESTful API design (**OpenAPI/Swagger**) paired with a test-driven mindset using **JUnit** and **Mockito**

We are seeking a Java Engineer to lead the design, development, and modernization of enterprise-grade applications that support AI-driven and intelligent digital capabilities. The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong technical expertise, ownership and drive high-quality delivery.

* Solid expertise in JPA/Hibernate, JDBC, and relational databases (SQL)

Consultant: 3+ years of experience

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced SAS developer to join a legacy modernisation programme that is moving an established SAS estate onto Snowflake The person in this role will be the teams authority on what the existing SAS code actually does reading Base SAS and SAS macro programs tracing the data lineage behind them and translating that logic into Snowflake and modern ELT pipelines without changing business outcomes

This is a handson engineering role rather than a support role Expect to spend most of your time in code in reconciliation and in conversation with the business users who rely on the reports and datasets being migrated The work is well suited to someone who has lived inside a large SAS codebase and now wants to carry that knowledge into a cloud data platform

Key Responsibilities

Analyse and document the existing SAS estate Base SAS programs macros PROC SQL DATA steps scheduled jobs and stored processes and produce the code inventory complexity rating and dependency map that drive the migration wave plan

Convert SAS logic into equivalent Snowflake stored procedures and ELT pipelines preserving business rules joins aggregations formats and edgecase handling rather than reimplementing from assumption

Own data reconciliation between the SAS output and the Snowflake output build rowcount controltotal and recordlevel comparison scripts investigate breaks and sign off each migrated object against agreed tolerance

Reengineer SAS data access layers that read from files RDBMS sources and SAS datasets so they land in Snowflake through the programmes chosen ingestion pattern

Work with the architecture team on target data models translating SASera structures into curated Snowflake schemas that suit setbased processing

Tune migrated workloads for cost and performance warehouse sizing clustering pruning and query rewrites so that converted jobs meet or beat their existing batch windows

Engage report owners and business analysts to confirm interpretation of legacy logic retire redundant code instead of migrating it and support user acceptance testing through to cutover

Maintain migration artefacts mapping documents conversion standards test evidence and runbooks and mentor junior engineers on reading SAS code safely

MustHave Skills

Strong handson Base SAS SAS Macro PROC SQL and DATA step development including formats informats arrays hash objects and bygroup processing

Proven ability to read and reverseengineer undocumented longlived SAS programs and explain what they do in business terms

Advanced SQL with practical exposure to Snowflake virtual warehouses stages streams tasks time travel cloning and micropartition behaviour

Experience on at least one completed legacytocloud data migration with responsibility for validation and reconciliation not only code conversion

Working knowledge of Python or a comparable scripting language for conversion accelerators automated comparison and repetitive refactoring

Comfortable with version control structured testing and defect tracking in a deliverymanaged environment

* Strong experience with AWS, including services related to compute, networking, security, and serverless architectures.
* Advanced expertise in Terraform and reusable infrastructure-as-code design.
* Strong scripting or software engineering capability in Python or Golang.
* Strong understanding of DevSecOps principles and controls, including SAST, DAST, SCA, SBOM, and software supply chain security.

* Solid grasp of security-by-design, the least privilege, and secure architecture principles.
* Experience building scalable, reusable, modular platform solutions rather than one-off implementations.

* Minimum 8+ years in software, systems, or integration engineering, including experience directly managing engineers (as an EM, or as a senior/staff engineer with clear, demonstrable people leadership experience) is required.

title: Vulnerability and Patch Manager
description:
Overview:

Expleo is a trusted partner for end-to-end, integrated engineering, quality services, and management consulting for digital transformation. We help businesses harness technological change to deliver innovation, improve resilience, and support the secure delivery of complex products, platforms, and systems.

As part of the Expleo UK Cybersecurity Practice, you will join a managed Cyber Operations service for a major UK energy network operator that forms part of the UK's Critical National Infrastructure (CNI). The service is governed by Expleo in the UK, with a 24/7 UK Security Operations Centre delivered by a specialist partner and an Expleo consultancy team in India providing design, engineering and assurance expertise across the client's security tooling estate.

As **Vulnerability and Patch Manager**, you will lead the vulnerability intelligence, prioritisation and patch advisory service across the client's server, end-user, network and security device estate, coordinating remediation through the client's operational teams and suppliers.

**This is a design, review and advisory role.** You will work within Expleo's offshore consultancy team, outside the client's operational environment. You will not have access to the client's operational systems or data and will not make live changes. Operational changes are implemented by UK-based, security-cleared personnel; your work provides the designs, analysis, recommendations and assurance that those changes depend on. You will work from information released to the team through Expleo's controlled UK service boundary.

Responsibilities:

**Responsibilities**

* Lead a continuous vulnerability assessment programme, using outputs from the client's vulnerability management platform released through the UK service boundary.
* Prioritise vulnerabilities using threat-informed criteria (CVSS, EPSS, CISA KEV, NCSC advisories and vendor PSIRTs) and produce monthly remediation recommendations.
* Issue critical patch advisories, typically within 24 hours, based on client guidance and credible threat intelligence, to enable expedited remediation by UK-based personnel and client suppliers.
* Produce a monthly report on vendor patch and firmware releases across the server, end-user, mobile, network and security estate.
* Produce OS patch and device firmware compliance reports.
* Consolidate patch and upgrade status reporting for firewalls, intrusion prevention, email gateway, secure web gateway and application control platforms.
* Track intrusion prevention signature (digital vaccine) compliance against the 48-hour target, working with the Security Engineer | Network.
* Maintain the vulnerability exception and risk acceptance register and present items for decision through service governance.
* Prepare and co-facilitate the monthly vulnerability and patch review with the UK Head of Service, client teams and third-party suppliers.
* Carry out targeted vulnerability analysis in support of incidents and investigations when directed.
* Apply safe practice for operational technology (OT) assets, where scanning and patching are constrained.
* Support the growth of Expleo's Cybersecurity Practice through knowledge sharing and technical contribution.

Qualifications:

* Degree in computer science, cybersecurity or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* Vulnerability management vendor certification, e.g. Rapid7, Tenable or Qualys (at least one required).
* CompTIA CySA+, PenTest+, GIAC GEVA, or ITIL 4 Foundation would be advantageous.

Essential skills:

* Vulnerability management platforms (e.g. Rapid7 InsightVM, Tenable, Qualys) and interpretation of their outputs.
* Patch management processes and tooling (e.g. Intune/MECM, Ivanti, Tanium, BigFix).
* Threat-informed prioritisation using CVSS, EPSS, CISA KEV and vendor advisories.
* Coordinating remediation across internal teams and third-party suppliers.
* Strong reporting and data analysis (Excel, Power BI).
* Clear, concise written advisories for technical and non-technical audiences.

Desired skills:

* OT vulnerability management and safe scanning practice.
* Energy, utilities or other CNI sector experience.
* Experience supporting NIS or CAF-aligned assurance reporting.

Experience:

* 8-12 years in IT security or infrastructure, including 4+ years managing vulnerability and patch management programmes.
* Experience running risk exception and acceptance processes through governance.

What do I need before I apply:

* Have the right to work in India.
* Be based in, or willing to relocate to, Chennai.
* Be willing to complete Expleo enhanced pre-employment background screening *(equivalent in standard to the UK Baseline Personnel Security Standard)* and any additional vetting the client requires.
* Be able to work hours that overlap with the UK business day, with occasional out-of-hours advisory support during major incidents.
* Have excellent written and spoken English, suitable for engagement with senior UK stakeholders.
* Be comfortable working within a strict security boundary, with no access to the client's operational systems or data.

Benefits:

* Collaborative working environment: we stand shoulder to shoulder with our clients and our peers through good times and challenges.
* We empower all passionate, technology-loving professionals to expand their skills and take part in inspiring projects.
* Expleo Academy enables you to acquire and develop the right skills by delivering a suite of accredited training courses.
* Competitive local company benefits *[India HR to confirm the benefits package].*
* Always working as one team, our people are not afraid to think big and challenge the status quo.

“We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons regardless of their race, sex, disability, religion/belief, sexual orientation or age.”

If you are an experienced vulnerability management professional who can turn vulnerability data into clear, prioritised action, we encourage you to apply today.

We are seeking a Senior Engineer I – Validation for Microchip’s MCU division to support validation and characterization of 8, 16 and 32- bit microcontrollers.

Microchip is a world leader in 8, 16, and 32- bit microcontrollers. The Validation Engineer position is focused on helping with development of our digital and parametric testing infrastructure. Significant time will be spent developing test cases, performing lab bench experiments, and assisting other team members in the validation of 8, 16 and 32- bit microcontrollers at unit and system-level. This position is based in Bangalore or Chennai, India. As a Validation Engineer, you will work with worldwide teams located in France, USA, Philippines, India and other corporate team members.

  

* Develop and implement functional, performance and system level/use-case validation of 8, 16 and 32- bit microcontrollers
* Experience with Microcontrollers, FPGAs, and in general, Embedded Systems. Familiar with embedded ARM Cortex M family, RISC-V, MIPS is preferred

* Candidate will have the primary role of creating, auditing, and overseeing test procedures, validation plans, data collection, post-processing of validation data, reports, and documenting results.
* Candidate should be familiar with using lab equipment such as Oscilloscopes, Logic Analyzers, Power Supplies, Arbitrary Waveform and Pulse generators, etc.
* Proficient in interpreting PCB schematics and PCB layouts.
* Develop performance tests for determining circuit margin and datasheet parameters.
* Develop automated lab-based testing of microcontroller for both digital and analog modules at the unit level and at the full chip level and should be able to troubleshoot and resolve issues found during validation
* Design or assist in the development of new testing infrastructure for use within the validation team
* Drive design recommendations to improve the validation process, such as enhancements to test software and hardware environments, lab equipment usage, and data management.
* Work with the validation team on customer support requests for released products.
* Work in an international environment (Europe, Asia, USA) with diverse functional groups (Architecture, Analog/Digital Design, Verification, Emulation, Applications, Marketing, Product and Test Engineering).

**Requirements/Qualifications:**

* Experience with Clock subsystem and Reset subsystems (BOR, POR, Bandgap, WDT etc.) and exposure to Analog peripherals (ADCs, DACs, Comparators, Op-AMPs, CTMU).
* Exposure to bench automation tools (NI Tools - LabView/TestStand) and scripting languages is add-on
* Experience in application development, system level test development
* Strong analytical and problem-solving / debug skills. Code and System debugging skills using in-circuit emulators and lab equipment such as oscilloscope/logic analyzer.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Able to work well in a team environment and adapt real-time.
* Able to think of test cases and customer usage model that may violate the assumptions of designers and architects.
* Able to prioritize tasks and execute to rigorous and dynamic schedules.
* Able to understand and generate board schematics, board design - schematic entry, BOM creation, net list generation (logical board design)
* Comprehensive record keeping and detailed debugging notes.

**Qualification:**

Bachelor’s degree in Electrical / Electronics or Computer Engineering (or equivalent) with at least 5 to 7 years of related work experience.

No Travel

description:
**Advanced Associate, Cloud Service Engineer**

**Location:** Chennai, India (Hybrid)

**Team:** Atlassian Administration & Engineering

**Experience:** 2+ years in Atlassian administration or a related platform engineering role

**About the Role**

We’re looking for an Atlassian engineer with a few years of experience to join our Atlassian Administration & Engineering team. You’ll work with a team of seven engineers who support a global Atlassian Cloud platform used by about 10,000–12,000 people around the world, across Jira, Confluence, Jira Product Discovery (JPD), and Jira Service Management (JSM).

We recently finished a large migration to Atlassian Cloud, and we’re still bringing separate product instances together into one environment. The migration moved fast and left technical debt behind, so we’re now focused on cleanup: removing legacy customizations and making the platform match Atlassian Cloud best practices. You’ll own parts of that work yourself. That means spotting problems, proposing fixes, and building automation that keeps the platform clean and scalable.

**What You’ll Do**

* **Platform administration:** Take ownership of administration across Jira, Confluence, JPD, and JSM, including permissions, schemes, workflows, custom fields, and space and project configuration.
* **User lifecycle automation:** Design and maintain automated onboarding and offboarding, group management, and license management, working with identity providers and SCIM provisioning.
* **Space and project lifecycle:** Build repeatable, automated processes to create, standardize, and archive projects and spaces at scale.
* **Reduce legacy customizations:** Audit the environment for redundant custom fields, workflows, schemes, and app dependencies. Then propose and carry out plans to remove or consolidate them, using automation wherever possible.
* **Automation engineering:** Build and maintain Atlassian Automation rules for routine and bulk administrative work. Where built-in features fall short, design robust API-driven automation.
* **Engineering practices:** Treat platform automation as production code. Changes are peer-reviewed, tested, and released through a pipeline, not run ad hoc.
* **AI-assisted engineering:** Make AI part of your everyday workflow, from drafting scripts and analyzing configurations to writing documentation, so you deliver more without lowering the quality bar.
* **Service metrics and observability:** Capture service metrics through the Atlassian APIs, store them outside the platform, and build dashboards that show how the service is used and how it’s performing.
* **Solution evaluation:** Weigh built-in Atlassian features against custom or external solutions, and explain clearly why the chosen option is the best fit.
* **Continuous improvement:** Challenge processes that are overly complex, costly, or full of manual toil, and propose simpler, automated alternatives.
* **Best practices and governance:** Help define standards, naming conventions, and configuration guidelines for each product, and document them.
* **Instance consolidation:** Contribute to ongoing migration and consolidation work, including planning, data validation, and post-migration cleanup.
* **Escalations and mentoring:** Resolve complex platform issues, and share knowledge with less experienced teammates and stakeholders.

**What We’re Looking For**

**Required:**

* 2+ years of hands-on administration of Jira and/or Confluence, preferably in Atlassian Cloud
* Working experience with Atlassian Automation, including building and troubleshooting rules
* Scripting skills in Python, PowerShell, or a similar language, and experience building automation against REST APIs (including JSON, authentication, pagination, and rate limits)
* Hands-on experience with Git and version-controlled code or configuration, plus a working understanding of CI/CD practices: build, test, release, versioning, and branching strategies
* Daily, effective use of AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or Claude, with the judgment to validate, refine, or reject what they produce
* A solid understanding of Jira configuration: schemes, workflows, screens, fields, and permissions
* Experience managing users and groups at scale in Atlassian Admin
* The ability to analyze an existing configuration, recommend simplifications, and explain the trade-offs clearly
* Clear written and verbal communication in English, and comfort working with stakeholders around the world
* A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related field, or equivalent experience

**Nice to have:**

* Atlassian certifications (ACP-120, ACP-620, or Cloud Organization Admin)
* Experience with AWS services (such as Timestream, Lambda, or S3) and with dashboards in Grafana or similar tools
* Experience administering JSM (request types, queues, SLAs, portals) or JPD
* Experience with identity integration such as Okta, Azure AD/Entra ID, SAML SSO, or SCIM
* Migration experience with JCMA/CCMA or instance merges
* Experience with ScriptRunner or other marketplace apps, and with assessing app usage

**What You’ll Gain**

* Ownership of meaningful parts of a large, enterprise-scale Atlassian Cloud platform
* Real influence over how a global platform is standardized and modernized
* A clear growth path to Specialist and Advanced Specialist roles on the Atlassian Platform Engineering team
* Support for Atlassian certifications and ongoing learning

description:
**Job Description:**

**About Us**

At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
  
  
Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.
  
  
We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths - whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.
  
  
Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role-specific responsibilities and business needs.
  
  
At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!

**Global Business Services**

Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.

Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.

In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
  
  
**Process Overview:**

The Global Information Security (GIS) role is responsible for protecting the organization’s information assets, systems, and data across global operations. This role ensures confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information by implementing security controls, monitoring threats, managing risks, and ensuring compliance with internal policies and regulatory requirements.

**Job Description:**

We invite you to join the GIS team as an Informatica and Oracle DB Data Engineer. We are a tight-knit, supportive community passionate about delivering the best experience for our customers while remaining sensitive to their unique needs.

The Data Engineer acts as the technical developer for Oracle and Informatica solutions within a project or program. This role combines senior-level hands-on development with technical leadership, estimation, design decisions, and team mentoring.

**Responsibilities:**

**Technical Data Engineer**

* Own end-to-end design and delivery of PL/SQL and ETL components
* Define coding standards, performance benchmarks, and best practices
* Review and approve technical designs, code, and ETL workflows

  

**Delivery & Stakeholder Interaction**

* Collaborate with architects, product owners, and business stakeholders
* Provide technical estimates, risk assessment, and delivery plans
* Support releases, production deployments, and major incident resolution

  

**Oracle Development (PL/SQL)**

* Design, develop, and maintain complex Oracle PL/SQL components, including: (Stored Procedures, Functions, Packages, Triggers, Views and Materialized Views)

* Write and optimize complex SQL queries for high-volume transactional and analytical systems
* Implement efficient data processing logic using BULK COLLECT, FORALL, cursors, and collections
* Enforce coding standards, best practices, and documentation for PL/SQL development
* Work closely with data modelers and architects to ensure optimal schema and index design
* Provide support for production issues, bug fixes, and performance enhancements

  

**Informatica (ETL) Development**

* Hands-on development and maintenance of Informatica PowerCenter mappings, sessions, and workflows
* Design end-to-end ETL solutions for Data Warehousing and operational systems
  + Strong experience with Informatica transformations including: (Source Qualifier, Lookup (connected/unconnected), Joiner, Aggregator, Router, Expression, Filter, Update Strategy)
* Experience handling slowly changing dimensions (SCDs), incremental loads, and data validation checks
* Ability to analyze and resolve ETL job failures and data issues

**Job Summary**
---------------

A Data Analyst interprets data and helps turn it into information that enables or improves a business process, thus affecting business decisions. Data Analysts gather information from various sources and interpret patterns and trends to make it digestible for others. They must have strong analytical skills, but above all have a burning curiosity to understand, and make sense of, data. They will work closely with:
  
• Data Managers, who define the team's business requirements, objectives, strategy and priorities
  
• Data Engineers, who design and implement the processes by which data is collected and generated
  
• Data Quality Analysts, who define data quality control requirements and oversee these on a day to day basis to ensure constant system health
  
• Upstream data teams, who provide the data that the analyst is sourcing
  
• Downstream Process Owners, who depend on the data to perform their business function
  
Data Analysts spend much of their time working with stakeholders to define data requirements, data transformation logic and supporting the delivery of these requirements from start to finish. They are experts in profiling data to understand its contents and will also have a working understanding of the business process or product that generated it in the first place. Data Analysts are the entry point to the FCC Data Team for most external stakeholders and as such will have a broad, but still detailed, understanding of all the data available and constantly seek opportunities for innovation and expansion. They are the primary liaison between up- and downstream teams

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Responsibilities for FCC Data Analysts:**  
• Define clear, concise and detailed business requirements for FCC Data that clearly document the data elements and formats that are needed, outline detailed transformation expectations and list the critical data elements that will enable downstream processes to operate effectively
  
• Create and maintain documentation that articulates the process by which data is extracted, transformed and loaded in FCC that can be shared and understood by others
  
• Work with downstream FCC business process owners to constantly improve, refine and expand the datasets to improve the quality and effectiveness of those processes, as well as help them to make sense of the data, providing training where required, and derive meaningful BI / MI
  
• Conduct detailed analysis of upstream changes that impact FCC data – for example the introduction of a new products – to ensure that requirements remain up to date and define any new ones as necessary
  
• Identify areas of overlap or data gaps that can lead to increased value, either by eliminating redundant processes or expanding existing data models
  
• Produce accurate and insightful dashboards and reports detailing the health, content and insights available from the data, making that actionable for stakeholders and meaningful for management decision making

**Skills and Experience**
-------------------------

**Must-have Skills**  
• SQL Querying skills
  
• Payments knowledge of Swift network and ISO 20022
  
• Banking domain knowledge
  
**Other Skills**  
• AML knowledge
  
• Interpersonal skills
  
• Stakeholder Management

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Skills and Eligibility**  
• Minimum 10+ years of professional experience as business change analyst in financial markets related banking products
  
• Degree (or similar) in Engineering and MBA is preferred
  
• A strong understanding of Cash Management systems or Payment Systems or Core Banking functionality / data flows – will be desired
  
• Good understanding of systems and data flows in Financial Crime Compliance / Anti Money Laundering etc. will be an added advantage
  
• Able to seamlessly move and translate between detailed functional data requirements and non-technical general terms
  
• The ability to write clear, concise and detailed business requirements that can be understood by data engineers and developers as well as business stakeholders
  
• Strong understanding of Cash Management systems or Payment Systems or Core Banking functionality / data flows – will be desired
  
• Competence with data profiling tools and methodologies (SQL at a minimum), with a preference for dedicated and sophisticated tools such as Paxata or Tableau
  
• Familiar with data documentation, delivery workflow and defect tracking tools – JIRA and Confluence in particular
  
• Demonstrated experience in handling and understanding large datasets and relational databases
  
• Experience in analytical roles with a large technical component, although not necessarily from a purely data perspective (e.g. they may have prior working knowledge of upstream or downstream processes that is relevant from a data perspective)
  
• Evidenced ability to execute and enhance a process to maintain data transformation requirements over time and constantly seek to improve these
  
• High quality written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to focus on multiple initiatives and data subjects (types of data or varying sources of data) at the same time
  
• Evidence a very strong attention to detail, reflecting the very low tolerance for error in FCC data

title: Engineer III GT – Integration Operations
description:
**Company Description**

**About the Company**

**Expeditors** is a **Fortune 500** global logistics leader headquartered in **Bellevue, Washington**. With a worldwide network of over **335+ locations across 100 countries**, we employ more than **20,000 trained professionals** dedicated to solving the increasingly sophisticated needs of international trade through customized solutions and seamless, integrated information systems.

**About the Expeditors Chennai GCC**

The **Global Capability Center (GCC)** in **Chennai, India**, is a core strategic arm of **Expeditors Corporate Headquarters (CHQ) – Information Services**.

Today, our thriving hub of **500+ employees** is responsible for delivering **world-class information services** on a global scale. As a vital pillar of the organization, the Chennai GCC drives **measurable value** for our people, our business, and our global customers.

We are committed to **technological excellence** and will continue to **pioneer innovative services** as we grow responsibly in the coming years. **Join us** and be a part of a strategic team that **moves the world**.

 **Job Description**

**Role Summary:**

The Engineer III is an experienced individual contributor who independently designs, develops, implements, and supports secure, reliable, scalable, and maintainable enterprise integration solutions. The role combines strong EDI and API engineering capabilities with technical ownership across middleware, messaging, file-based interfaces, automation, modernization, and platform services. The Engineer III consistently delivers high-quality work, contributes to technical decisions and design reviews, guides peers and junior engineers, and helps shape solutions across systems, services, platforms, and products within the assigned domain.

Working across engineering teams and business stakeholders, the Engineer III drives complex integration delivery, strengthens operational resilience, improves code quality and performance, promotes engineering standards, and translates business and customer needs into effective technical solutions. The role also contributes through mentoring, knowledge sharing, documentation, continuous improvement, and portfolio or department-level initiatives.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Software, API, and Platform Development**

* Design, develop, configure, test, implement, and support application components, services, APIs, EDI translations, middleware integrations, and platform capabilities.
* Independently develop and maintain REST-based APIs, web services, system interfaces, reusable components, and automation utilities using established engineering standards and architectural patterns.
* Perform thorough self-reviews and code reviews, provide actionable feedback to peers and junior engineers, and improve the maintainability, reliability, security, and performance of solutions.
* Develop and maintain automated testing strategies, including unit, integration, API, and end-to-end test coverage to improve software quality and reliability
* Optimize complex code, mapping logic, services, and integration flows to reduce processing time, resource usage, defects, and repeated implementation effort.
* Use approved AI-assisted development tools responsibly to support coding, testing, documentation, defect detection, and technical analysis while maintaining established quality and security standards.

**EDI and Enterprise Integration Delivery**

* Design, develop, and support enterprise integrations across ANSI X12, EDIFACT, XML, JSON, CSV, flat files, APIs, middleware, messaging, event-driven communication, and managed file-transfer patterns.
* Own complex EDI and integration projects, including requirement interpretation, mapping and transformation logic, interface design, validation, testing, implementation, deployment, and post-production support.
* Analyze input and output data, envelopes, acknowledgements, partner configurations, routes, canonical structures, and downstream system behavior to confirm accuracy, completeness, and expected processing.
* Troubleshoot complex applications, API, middleware, mapping, dataflow, transactions, communication, and performance issues by isolating root causes and implementing sustainable solutions.
* Identify technical risks, dependencies, and downstream impacts early, and recommend mitigation approaches for complex or cross-system changes.
* Contribute reusable integration patterns, utilities, templates, and documentation that improve quality and consistency, acceleratetime to market, and strengthen team effectiveness.

**API Engineering and Modernization**

* Design, consume, test, secure, document, and support REST APIs and related system interfaces, including API contracts, request and response structures, validation, error handling, and versioning considerations.
* Contribute to API enablement that complements EDI capabilities and supports modern, reusable, and self-service integration experiences where appropriate.
* Apply microservices, messaging, event-driven, distributed system, and domain-driven design concepts to assign solutions when applicable.
* Contribute to application modernization initiatives, including migration from legacy platforms to modern architecture and engineering practices.
* Collaborate with platform, architecture, security, product, and adjacent engineering teams to align API and integration solutions with enterprise patterns and strategic objectives.

**Technical Design and Architecture**

* Lead or actively contribute to technical design for systems of significant size and near- to mid-term business impact.
* Participate actively in technical design reviews, provide feedback on other designs, incorporate feedback, and help shape technical decisions of significant complexity, ensuring alignment with Engineering Principles and architectural standards.
* Apply Engineering Principles and approved architectural patterns to improve modularity, interoperability, reliability, scalability, maintainability, security, and observability.
* Evaluate system dependencies, design tradeoffs, operational impacts, failure modes, and downstream effects when developing or changing solutions.
* Document technical designs, API contracts, data mappings, implementation decisions, test evidence, deployment details, operational procedures, and support findings.

**Engineering Practices and Operational Excellence**

* Own technical decisions for daily work and ensure conformity to Engineering Principles, coding standards, development processes, security practices, and deployment procedures.
* Actively enable Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery through automated builds, testing, quality checks, and deployment practices.
* Implement and maintain monitoring, observability, telemetry, logging, alerting, and operational automation capabilities to improve system resilience and operational excellence**.**
* Participate in production support and on-call rotations; guide operational resilience for systems contributed to and engage effectively in incident management and response.
* Contribute to operational and security automation and identify recurring support or delivery activities that can be simplified or automated.
* Continuously improve code quality, system performance, delivery efficiency, and customer experience through root-cause analysis and preventive action.

  
**Qualifications**

**Minimum Qualifications**

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical discipline; an equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.

**Experience**

* 8+ years of professional experience in software development, application integration, platform support, API development, middleware, or related engineering discipline
* Progressive experience in software development, enterprise application integration, API development, EDI, middleware, platform engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
* Experience independently delivering complex integration solutions and contributing to technical design and solution architecture decisions.
* Experience developing and supporting production integrations, participating in incident response and operational support, and improving system resilience.
* Experience performing code and design reviews, providing technical feedback, and mentoring less experienced engineers.
* Experience collaborating across teams to deliver technology solutions and business outcomes using agile delivery, source control, testing, and modern engineering workflows.

**Technical Skills and Knowledge**

* Strong knowledge of software development lifecycle, object-oriented programming, software design, testing principles, defect resolution, release processes, and deployment practices.
* Strong EDI knowledge, including ANSI X12, EDIFACT, XML, JSON, CSV, flat files, mapping and transformation, envelopes, acknowledgements, partner setup, routing, and transaction troubleshooting.
* Experience designing, developing, consuming, testing, securing, and documenting REST APIs, web services, and system interfaces.
* Experience with integration concepts and technologies including middleware, messaging, event-driven communication, file transfer, communication protocols, canonical data models, and distributed systems.
* Experience with middleware or integration platforms such as webMethods, IBM Sterling, Seeburger, MuleSoft, Boomi, or equivalent technologies.
* Experience with API management concepts, microservices architecture, error handling, versioning, authentication and authorization, and interface observability.
* Working knowledge of SQL, relational database concepts, data structures, data relationships, and database connectivity.
* Experience with source control, code review, CI/CD, GitHub or Azure DevOps, DevOps methods, cloud technologies, and automated testing.
* Understanding of secure development, telemetry, observability, monitoring, incident management, operational automation, and production support.
* Ability to analyze complex technical problems, optimize code and integration logic, evaluate design tradeoffs, and recommend effective solutions.
* Ability to leverage AI-powered engineering tools for code generation, testing, troubleshooting, documentation, design analysis, and productivity improvements.

**Desired Qualifications**

* Experience in Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain, Freight Forwarding, Retail, Distribution, customs, order management, or related business processes.
* Experience with webMethods Integration Server, Trading Networks, Universal Messaging, EDI standards, canonical models, shared services, or comparable enterprise integration capabilities.
* Experience with API management, microservices, event-driven architecture, domain-driven design, distributed systems, GraphQL, Apache Kafka, JMS, or MQ.
* Experience with Java and modern frameworks, automated test frameworks, and development environments relevant to the assigned team.
* Knowledge on Docker, Kubernetes, and container orchestration platforms is an added advantage.
* Knowledge on cloud-native application development and deployment patterns.
* Experience implementing security automation and DevSecOps practices.
* Experience with AI-assisted testing, AI-driven code analysis, and Generative AI technologies.
* Exposure to Agentic AI concepts and AI-enabled software engineering practices.
* Experience designing reusable integration frameworks, shared utilities, self-service capabilities, or automation that accelerates onboarding and delivery.
* Experience contributing to cross-team initiatives, technical communities of practice, standards, job aids, technical training, or internal knowledge publications.
* Exposure to ERP, WMS, TMS, customs, order management, or other enterprise business applications.
* Experience using observability, telemetry, operational analytics, and performance tuning to improve production reliability and customer outcomes.

  
**Additional Information**

Expeditors offers excellent benefits:

* Paid Vacation, Holiday, Sick Time
* Health Plan: Medical
* Life Insurance
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Training and Personnel Development Program
* Growth opportunities within the company
* Employee Referral Program Bonus

**Role Overview**  
  
The ETC – Endpoint Management supports the design, implementation, and optimization of enterprise endpoint management solutions with a primary focus on Microsoft Intune for iOS, Android, and macOS platforms. Under supervision, the role contributes to the provisioning, configuration, and lifecycle management of mobile and desktop devices across the organization, ensuring secure, compliant, and cost-effective IT environments. The role also supports print infrastructure and collaborates with cross-functional teams to address integration challenges, enhance connectivity, and maintain reliability across diverse deployment models. The engineer contributes to automation and self service principles as well as operates within an Agile delivery framework aligned to SAFe principles.  
  
**Key Responsibilities**  
  
**Endpoint Management & Mobile Device Management (MDM)**  
  

* Design, implement, and manage Microsoft Intune policies for iOS, Android, and macOS devices, ensuring compliance with organizational security standards.
* Enroll, configure, and maintain corporate and BYOD devices across all supported platforms, including application deployment, conditional access policies, and device compliance baselines.
* Troubleshoot device enrollment, configuration profile, and policy assignment issues across iOS, Android, and macOS endpoints.
* Maintain and update endpoint configurations to align with evolving security requirements and platform OS updates.

  
**Print Infrastructure Support**  
  

* Support the administration and maintenance of enterprise print environments, including print server management, driver deployment via Intune, and printer policy configuration.
* Assist in troubleshooting printing issues across Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android devices, ensuring seamless print connectivity for end users.
* Contribute to the evaluation and implementation of cloud-based printing solutions integrated with the existing MDM ecosystem.

  
**Infrastructure Design and Implementation**  
  

* Assist in developing and implementing scalable infrastructure solutions across cloud and on-premises environments to improve system performance and reliability, including operating system maintenance and backup processes.
* Support cross-functional collaboration to define network, storage, compute, and connectivity requirements, ensuring alignment with project goals and business objectives.
* Contribute to infrastructure design reviews by validating adherence to best practices and assisting with documentation for automation and Infrastructure as Code (IaC).

  
**Continuous Monitoring and Improvement**  
  

* Monitor device compliance, endpoint health, and Intune policy effectiveness, assisting with troubleshooting to maintain uptime and operational reliability.
* Help evaluate and integrate new technologies to optimize endpoint management capabilities and support cost efficiency.
* Participate in regular infrastructure assessments to identify areas for improvement, ensuring endpoint security posture and disaster recovery (DR) readiness.

  
**Security Controls Embedded in Infrastructure**  
  

* Support collaboration with security teams to implement and maintain secure device configurations, encryption, and compliance measures across endpoint infrastructure components.
* Assist with vulnerability assessments and remediation activities, contributing to a secure and resilient IT environment.
* Help validate HA and DR plans to ensure alignment with security and continuity requirements.

  
**Job Family, Sub-Job Family & Area of Focus**  
  
**Job Family:** Information and Technology Solutions  
**Sub-Job Family:** Engineering  
**Area of Focus:** Infrastructure Engineering — with specialization in Endpoint Management, MDM, and Print Services.

**Selection Criteria**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, with a minimum of 2 years of relevant experience; or equivalent combination of education and experience (e.g., Bachelor's Degree in IT with at least 1 year of related work experience).
* Demonstrated hands-on experience with Microsoft Intune managing iOS, Android, and macOS device fleets in an enterprise environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**  
  

* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Intune and endpoint operating systems (iOS, Android, macOS, and Windows), demonstrating strong expertise in device and platform management.
* Skilled in cloud computing, networking, and configuration management, enabling effective deployment, maintenance, and optimization of enterprise IT environments.
* Experienced in implementing and supporting security control frameworks and print infrastructure/cloud print services to ensure secure and reliable IT operations.
* Proficient in Agile methodologies (SAFe) and project support, contributing effectively to project planning, execution, and delivery.
* Strong analytical reasoning skills with the ability to assess issues, identify solutions, and support data-driven decision-making.
* Working knowledge of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and System Development Life Cycle (SDLC) concepts, with the ability to apply and support modern technology solutions.

* SAFe Practitioner (SP) (preferred)
* SAFe for Teams or higher SAFe certification (preferred)

title: Data Capability Engineer
description:
**Job title:** Data Capability Engineer**Location:** Chennai**Reports to:** IT Systems Architecture**Contract:** Permanent, Full\-time **Purpose of the Role:**
Own and extend the accuracy, completeness, and usability of the service management platform's data — so implementation teams and AI\-driven capabilities can act on it directly, and so priority consumers like vulnerability and exposure management run on complete, trustworthy ground truth. Service mapping and asset data are the anchor domain and immediate priority; the durable mandate is data quality across an increasingly AI\-centric ITSM platform, where automated systems act on data without a human to catch errors first.  

**A data\-capability role, not a security role.** **Core responsibilities — Anchor domain: Service \& asset data (immediate priority)**  

* Ensure existing service mapping is accurate and current across hosts, servers, and applications.
* Extend mapping coverage to data types not well covered today — certificates, websites, agents, and SaaS applications.
* Engage in the workflows that onboard new applications and capabilities into the CMDB so coverage keeps pace rather than drifting.
* Go deeper into discovery and software\-asset tooling — Lansweeper, the software asset management system, and agent\-based discovery — to raise inventory fidelity.
 **Core responsibilities — Broader mandate: Platform \& AI\-consumption data quality**  

* Apply the same discipline to other high\-value platform data — service catalog and metadata, ticket routing and assignment\-group data, and the Dataverse structures underneath delivery capabilities such as the AskIT service chatbot.
* Raise data to the standard AI systems require: complete, disambiguated, and semantically clean, so intent classification, catalog matching, and automated routing act on trustworthy inputs rather than amplifying noise.
* Leverage the existing foundation (Dataverse schema, discovery tooling, search indexes already in place) rather than building net\-new infrastructure.
* Make data consumable without re\-verification \- the test is whether an engineer or an automated agent can act on a record without re\-checking it, and turn recurring data problems into repeatable quality practices.
 **What this role is not**  

* **Not remediation coordination or change management**
* **Not a security function \-** it supplies the data; it does not own security decisions.
* **Not a net\-new platform build \-** leverages and improves the existing foundation.
 **Example Success measures**  

* **Coverage:** % of assets, certificates, websites, agents, and SaaS apps mapped to owner and service; extended over time to other platform data domains.
* **Data confidence:** high enough that implementation teams and AI capabilities don't require re\-verification.
* **Time\-to\-onboard** a new application or capability into the CMDB.
* **Reusability:** improvements delivered as repeatable practices, not one\-off fixes.
 **What You’ll Need:****Education:**  

Bachelor's degree in information systems, computer science, data management, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience. A candidate with a strong track record in CMDB, discovery, or data\-quality work should not be screened out for lack of the exact degree. **Experience:**  

Five to eight years in IT data, configuration/asset management, or a data\-engineering\-adjacent role, including demonstrable ownership of a data domain (not just contributing to one). Enough experience to set the standard for how data quality is done, with the judgment to work independently under a Senior Manager's direction rather than needing task\-level supervision. **Required skills and knowledge**  

**Anchor domain — asset \& service data**  

* Hands\-on experience with CMDB and service mapping concepts (configuration items, relationships, service dependencies), including keeping mapping accurate as the environment changes.
* Working knowledge of discovery and software\-asset tooling — Lansweeper, agent\-based discovery, and a software asset management system — and what drives inventory fidelity in each.
* Understanding of the asset types the role must extend into: certificates, websites, agents, and SaaS applications.
 **Broader mandate — platform \& AI\-consumption data quality**  

* Strong data\-quality fundamentals: profiling, deduplication, normalization, and defining and measuring completeness and accuracy.
* Practical experience querying and shaping data in a structured platform (Dataverse or a comparable relational/low\-code data platform), working with existing schema rather than designing greenfield systems.
* Query capability sufficient to investigate, validate, and correct data at scale independently.
* Familiarity with what makes data consumable by AI systems — why completeness, disambiguation, and clean semantics matter for intent classification, matching, and routing. Deep machine\-learning expertise is not required; the relevant skill is data readiness, not model building.
 **Ways of working**  

* Able to embed quality into existing onboarding workflows and turn recurring problems into repeatable practices, rather than one\-off fixes.
* Communicates data issues and their business impact clearly to both technical teams and non\-technical stakeholders.
 **Your Advantage:*** Experience in a Microsoft Power Platform environment (Power Automate, Azure AI Search, or similar).
* Exposure to vulnerability or exposure management as a data consumer — understanding what that function needs from asset data, without owning the security decisions.
* ITIL familiarity (service management context), or a data\-management certification (e.g., DAMA/CDMP).

**Job Description:**


**About Us**


At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths \- whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve. Bank of America is committed to an in\-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in\-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role\-specific responsibilities and business needs.
  

At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!


**Global Business Services**


Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations. Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.


In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.


**Process Overview**


Global Information Security (GIS) is responsible for protecting bank information systems, confidential and proprietary data, and customer information. GIS develops the bank’s Information Security strategy and policy, manages the Information Security program, identifies and addresses vulnerabilities and operates global security operations center that monitor, detects and responds to cybersecurity incidents. Within GIS, the Cloud Security organization is responsible for leading a team of deeply technical cyber security engineers and architects to design and implement best in class cyber security capabilities for internal and external cloud instances in partnership with infrastructure and application technology teams. In addition, lead efforts across other Global Information Security functions to enable cyber security technology and operations in cloud environments.


**Job Description**


This role is for GIS Penetration testing team to conduct penetration tests and source code reviews of our internal/external web, mobile, web, and web API service applications, leveraging both manual techniques as well as automated tools to uncover and report security vulnerabilities that exist.
  

  

You must be knowledgeable with business risks associated to common security vulnerabilities and to be able to effectively communicate complex technical concepts such as security vulnerabilities to application developers and/or senior managers who may have little to no experience with application security.
  

  

You must have the ability to work independently in a very large scale, enterprise setting and collaborate with peer team members. Previous experience as an application security professional with a large Financial Institution a plus.


**Responsibilities**


* Performs assigned analysis of internal and external threats on information systems and predict future threat behavior
* Incorporates threat actors' tactics, techniques, and procedures into offensive security testing
* Performs assessments of the security, effectiveness, and practicality of multiple technology systems
* Leverages innovative thinking to help solve problems or introduce new ideas to processes or products applicable to offensive security
* Prepares and presents detailed technical information for various media including documents, reports, and notifications
* Provides clear and practical advice regarding managed risks
* Learns and develops advanced technical and leadership skills; Mentor Junior assessors in technical tradecraft and soft skill

**Requirements**


**Education:** B.E. / B. Tech/M.E. /M. Tech


**Certifications, If Any:** GWAPT, CEH, OSCP, SANS, CEH


**Experience Range:** 6\+ years


**Foundational Skills:**


* Strong hands\-on experience in conducting comprehensive manual penetration tests and source code reviews against web, API, mobile applications, services, platforms, systems, and networks to identify security vulnerabilities.
* Solid experience in using various security tools such as Invicti, SoapUI, Burp Suite Pro, Checkmarx, Kali Linux, Metasploit, etc.
* Very Good Communication \& Interpersonal skills.
* Knowledge of network and Web related protocols/technologies.
* Experience with latest penetration testing techniques (e.g., web application proxies, packet capture analysis software, browser extensions, advanced penetration testing tools (full stack), Linux distributions, Windows OS, etc.).
* Experience of penetration testing on mobile platforms such as iOS, Android, and mobile device simulators.
* Solid programming/debugging skills with proficiency in one or more of the following: Java, JavaScript, HTML, XML, PHP, ASP.NET, AJAX, JSON, Python, Perl, Shell script, Objective\-C, and SOAP/REST web APIs.
* Expert\-level experience and knowledge in the following areas:


	+ Authentication and security protocols.
	+ Application session management.
	+ Applied cryptography.
	+ Common communication protocols.
	+ Mobile frameworks.
	+ Single sign\-on technologies.
	+ Development frameworks (Angular, React, etc.).
	+ Exploit automation platforms.
* Knowledge of a Structured Query Language.
* Developer experience or coding background (nice\-to\-have).

**Desired Skills:**


* Experience of penetration testing and source code reviews on web, API and mobile platforms.
* Solid programming/debugging skills with proficiency in one or more of the following: Java, JavaScript, HTML, XML, PHP, ASP.NET, AJAX, JSON, Objective\-C, and SOAP/REST web APIs.

**Work Timings:** 11:30 AM to 8:30 PM

**Job Description: Senior BI QA Lead**

The Senior Business Intelligence QA Tester is responsible for ensuring the quality, accuracy, and reliability of enterprise reporting, analytics, and data integration solutions. This role focuses on **testing Tableau dashboards, SSRS reports, and SSIS data integration** processes to ensure business requirements are met and data quality is maintained throughout the reporting lifecycle. The position works closely with Business Analysts, Data Engineers, BI Developers, and business stakeholders to identify defects, validate data integrity, and support the successful delivery of business intelligence solutions. The Senior BI QA Tester also drives testing standards, promotes best practices, and contributes to continuous improvements in data quality and reporting reliability.

 **Technical Skills**

  

* Extensive experience **testing Tableau dashboards** and analytics solutions.
* Strong experience validating **SSRS reports** and report subscriptions.
* Experience testing **SSIS packages**, **ETL workflows**, and data movement processes.
* Advanced **SQL** skills for data validation, reconciliation, and root cause analysis.
* Experience working with data warehouses, relational databases, and dimensional data models.
* Strong understanding of data integration, **ETL, ELT**, and reporting architectures.
* Experience using **Azure DevOps** for test management, defect tracking, and Agile delivery support.
* Experience with **API validation** and interface testing is desirable.
* Familiarity with Microsoft SQL Server, Azure Data Services, and cloud\-based BI platforms.

 **Analytical \& Problem\-Solving Skills**

  

* Ability to analyse complex business requirements and translate them into detailed test scenarios.
* Strong investigative and troubleshooting skills for identifying data quality and reporting issues.
* Ability to perform detailed root cause analysis across data pipelines and reporting solutions.
* Strong attention to detail with a focus on data accuracy and consistency.

 **Ownership \& Collaboration**

  

* Experience working closely with Business Analysts, BI Developers, Data Engineers, Product Owners, and business stakeholders.
* Ability to independently manage testing activities across multiple BI projects.
* Proven ability to influence quality practices and improve testing processes.

 **Quality \& Process Expertise**

  

* Experience developing BI testing strategies, standards, and best practices.
* Ability to define and measure quality metrics including defect leakage, test coverage, data quality indicators, and release readiness.
* Strong understanding of SDLC, Agile methodologies, and testing lifecycle management.

 **Soft Skills**

  

* High attention to detail and a proactive mindset.
* Strong sense of ownership and accountability.
* Ability to work independently and manage priorities in fast\-paced environments.
* Effective communication of complex issues in clear, concise language.

 **Experience Requirements**

  

* Typically, 10\+ years of QA experience, with at least 2\+ years in a senior or lead role.
* Demonstrated experience working in cross\-functional squads or Agile teams.
* Proven track record of delivering high\-quality releases in complex systems.

 **Preferred Certifications**

  

* STQB Foundation or Advanced Certification.
* Microsoft Data Platform or Azure Data certifications.
* Tableau Desktop Specialist or Tableau Certified Professional.
* Certified Software Quality Analyst (CSQA).

 **Specific Work Preferences**

  

* Experience testing enterprise\-scale reporting and analytics platforms.
* Strong understanding of healthcare, manufacturing, or regulated business environments.
* Experience validating large and complex datasets.
* Understanding of BI performance testing and report optimisation techniques.
* Familiarity with data governance, data lineage, and master data concepts.

 **Specific Skills and/or Business Competencies**

  

* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong SQL development and query\-writing capabilities.
* Advanced analytical and investigative mindset.
* High attention to detail and data accuracy.
* Experience working within Agile delivery teams.
* Ability to prioritise testing efforts based on business risk and impact.
* Strong understanding of business intelligence reporting, ETL processing, and data validation methodologies.
* Ability to challenge requirements and identify potential reporting or data quality risks proactively.

 **Leadership Competencies**

  

* Strategic thinker with the ability to translate quality goals into executable team programs.
* Strong people leader with a proven ability to develop, coach, and retain high\-performing QA teams.
* Effective communicator and collaborator across engineering, product, and executive stakeholders.
* Data\-driven decision maker with a strong focus on measurable quality outcomes.
* Proactive risk identifier with a relentless commitment to delivery excellence and client satisfaction.
